Whether it's driving new voter registration, helping bring lapsed donors back to voting, or informing regular voters about threats to our fundamental right to vote, we're going to work every day to fulfill the promise of our democracy.
Fuel our efforts with $15 or whatever you can right now to defend voting rights nationwide >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-infrastructure?refcode=100925_4&amount=15]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
folks,
Voter Action Project has an easy-to-understand mission: To increase voter participation across the country.
We have several goals to help guide us in accomplishing that mission -- expanding ballot access, meeting voters where they are, driving new voters to register, and reengaging lapsed voters to bring them back to participation.
This work keeps getting harder. We're not giving up, however, and we don't think we're alone in this fight for our fundamental right to vote.
Please, pitch in with $15 or whatever you can today to stand with us as we work to protect the right to vote for every American >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-infrastructure?refcode=100925_4&amount=15]

Voter Action Project started in 2020 with the simple idea that we should all be able to vote by mail during a deadly pandemic, where standing close to one another in voting lines might endanger our health.
We've evolved since then to recognize the threats to our rights and how critical the ability to vote is, whether you do it in person, by mail, early, or on Election Day.
We believe the simple truth that the more Americans who vote, the more our country represents the interests of the people and not the powerful.
Your support helps us power our grassroots efforts against the dark-money millions at work to restrict the right to vote. Chip in to help us fight back >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-infrastructure?refcode=100925_4&amount=15]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project

It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

name: All On The Line
subject: How our democracy is supposed to work
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
For a truly representative democracy with responsive, accountable leaders, we need fair maps.
|
---

Here’s how our democracy is _supposed_ to function, Peter:
1. Candidates lay out plans to try to appeal to as many voters as possible.

2. Voters use that information to decide which politicians will represent them.

3. Politicians are sworn into office with a duty to serve their constituents. And if leaders don’t follow the will of the people, they get voted out of office.

But this process gets completely warped by relentless, extreme gerrymandering:
1. Candidates run on extreme agendas because they only have to worry about winning primaries...

2. ...because politicians have drawn district lines to secure seats for their own party...

3. ...and voters don’t get a fair chance to hold those leaders accountable in competitive elections.

When politicians can insulate themselves from accountability by cherry-picking voters, it’s toxic for democracy.
Extremists around the country have been racing to pass new, mid-decade gerrymanders to silence even more voters and grab even more unearned power, from Texas and Missouri to Indiana and Florida.
**But with your support, we’re fighting for fair maps to put power where it belongs — in the hands of voters.** We’re rallying Americans to speak out to their lawmakers against map manipulation, pushing for redistricting reform, and building organizing muscle so we can continue responding to new threats as they emerge.

I am so proud that Colorado has been an oasis for reproductive rights – but it shouldn't have to be this way.
| | |
---
Friend –
In the three years since the Supreme Court majority ended the right to an abortion via the _Dobbs_ decision, **I am so grateful that Colorado has continued to be a safe haven for women to make decisions about their reproductive health care and have access to the care they need.**
**_[If you agree, then before I explain why that is, will you please chip in $5 or more now to help me keep it that way as our next governor?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116953188/574986972/43140476?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk946-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMDE0ZmQzMS02ZWE1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GPjE92iLZmGIwUaOTVA4pEUi2rF0txnGEWb1rOJbrUU=)_**

Today,**four of the seven states** bordering us have cracked down on abortion access, and the national GOP continues to use _Dobbs_ to go after other forms of reproductive care, like medication abortion, birth control, IVF, and more. Since 2022, maternal mortality rates have skyrocketed in states where abortion access is limited.
But I believe the right to choose shouldn't depend on where you live.
I believe all women, in Colorado and across the country, have the right to choose.
So that's why, during my time as a senator, and long before _Dobbs_ was on the docket, I've worked to ensure all Americans can access safe and affordable reproductive health care. Most recently, I joined my Democratic colleagues in reintroducing the Women’s Health Protection Act – both to reaffirm the right to choose nationwide and to save women's lives.
But with anti-abortion Republicans securely in the majority, it went nowhere.
That’s why I believe that, today, it is the states – not Washington – that will show our country the way forward. **And as Colorado’s governor, I'll continue to be an unwavering champion for reproductive health care access and fight back against any Trump administration action that infringes on the right to choose in our state. **
But with a far-right Republican in this race who supports _criminalizing_ abortion – **even in cases of rape or incest** – I can't follow through on my promise without your help today.

name: Saikat Chakrabarti
subject: Wow what a night! Thank you for kicking off our campaign.
body:
We had almost 800 people come to our kickoff rally last night. I still can't believe it. Thank you so much for coming!

| | | | | [|
---](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=336ee2eb54&e=bf17056ae8)
| | | | | |
Hi Everyone! WOW! We just held our first campaign rally and almost eight HUNDRED people showed up. And we’re still eight months out from the primary! It’s absolutely incredible, and, honestly, very surreal for me. I’m used to being in the background, helping others run for office. When I started this race, I didn’t know if I had what it takes to be a good candidate. I knew this would be an uphill battle, but I knew voters wanted real change and that there was a path to win. But you never know what’s possible until you try.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=504e93a853&e=bf17056ae8)
| |
Last night proved to me that we can do this. It’s not because of me. It’s because of the incredible amount of energy I felt in that room last night. It’s because of the 282 of you who signed up for [**846 days of door knocking**](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=70ab906d27&e=bf17056ae8)**!** It’s because of the scores who signed up for [**leafleting at markets**](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=38ec612c70&e=bf17056ae8) , to register voters in [**your apartment buildings**](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=cd609df186&e=bf17056ae8) , and to connect us with community organizations you belong to. And it’s because I know this energy and momentum is only going to grow from here on out. This campaign really is about all of us. We’re creating a new electoral force in San Francisco to finally fix what is broken in our country. And because of that, I’ve never felt as confident as I do now that we are going to win this race.When we did our office opening party a few months ago, we expected a couple hundred people to show up — and ended up with more than 500 people. So we upgraded the venue this time to the Chapel, but yet again, we went over capacity. I know a bunch of you came but weren’t able to get in. For that: thank you for coming, and I’m so sorry we weren’t able to get all of you in. But I’d still really love to meet you! I do small group video calls with SF residents every day. Usually there are just a handful of people and we really get a chance to talk. Please sign up for one!
---
| [Join a call with me!](https://saikat.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ed3ace2702e5b912b1693cee&id=1afe7034ef&e=bf17056ae8)
---
| |
Thanks again, everyone! This is just the beginning. LFG!!— Saikat

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Sheriff: "Keller's ICE Hotline Puts Officers' Lives at Risk"
body:
Former sheriff running again after watching catch & release destroy law enforcement: "30+ police shootings since 2017 in my county alone."

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=b8acb49125&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | | We had a [special guest this week](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=cbd94fd9fb&e=567664f14c) \- former San Juan County Sheriff Ken Christensen, who served two successful terms, retired for 8 years, and decided he can't sit on the sidelines anymore. **What he revealed about catch & release's impact on law enforcement should terrify every New Mexican.**
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=39ec0da8df&e=567664f14c)
| |
🚨 **CATCH & RELEASE CREATED 30+ POLICE SHOOTINGS**
Sheriff Christensen's devastating stat:
"Before catch & release in 2017, we went 50 years without killing anyone - we'd shot a few people who survived, but no deaths. Since 2017? 30 police shootings in San Juan County alone. Over 350 statewide."
The repeat offender cycle created by catch & release is putting officers in constant life-threatening situations they never faced before.

🔥 **"ELEANOR CHAVEZ IS AN IGNORANT FOOL"**
When we played NM Rep Eleanor Chavez comparing ICE to "the KKK," Sheriff Christensen didn't hold back:
"Those are the words of a complete ignorant fool who has no business representing anybody. When she says they're coming after us next - that would only mean she's a criminal."
On her dangerous rhetoric: "This is catnip for people on the edge of their own sanity. That language gives them the push to take up arms."
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=0a70552d5c&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
📞 **KELLER'S ICE HOTLINE "PUTS OFFICERS AT RISK"**
On Tim Keller's hotline where residents can call to find out if ICE is operating nearby:
"That puts every officer at risk. They could set up an ambush. Police officers get ambushed every single day - dead officers everywhere. We saw what happened in Dallas" (ICE ambush killed 2, wounded third).
"Why aren't police departments helping ICE? Let's get these illegal criminals out of our country, period."
💀 **SEATTLE MAYOR: "HE'S AN IDIOT"**
Seattle Mayor Bruce Harrell won't jail repeat offenders because "maybe they were abused as a child, maybe they're hungry."
Sheriff's response: "He's an idiot. I could care less when he committed murder, robbery, rape, or burglary. We can talk about that at sentencing."

body:

# **Are You Ready to Vote on Nov. 4th?**
Senator Hughes recently hosted a telephone townhall focused on the upcoming [November 4th election](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15623). **[LISTEN TO THE TELEPHONE TOWNHALL HERE](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15624)** The townhall provided voters with an opportunity to ask questions and hear directly about voting deadlines, creating a voting plan, and the importance of learning about who's on the ballot, including Pennsylvania judges.
* * *
## **Not Sure Who 's on the Ballot?**
[**View Philadelphia's sample ballot HERE**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15625) [**View Montgomery County's sample ballot HERE**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15626)
* * *
## **Important Dates**

* Election Day is **November 4th**
* Polls are open from 7AM to 8PM
* Deadline to register to vote is **October 20th**
* Deadline to request a mail-in or absentee ballot is **October 28th**
* You can [find your polling location by clicking here](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15627)
* Register online at [https://www.pa.gov/agencies/vote](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15628) or with your county election office
* If you have any questions, call Pennsylvania's voter hotline at **1-877-868-3772**
* If you have any questions or run into issues while voting, call the Philadelphia County Board of Elections at**215-686-3469**

* * *
## **Voting by Mail?**

* You must [apply for your mail-in ballot](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15629) by **October 28th at 5PM**
* The deadline to return your mail-in ballot is **November 4th by 8PM**
* Return your ballot as soon as possible to make sure it is received by November 4th
* You can return your mail-in ballot by mail or at a drop off location
* Philadelphia has drop box and satellite election offices where you can drop off your ballot. [You can find your closest drop off location online.](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15630)
* If you need help finding a drop off location or have questions about your mail in ballot, call our office at **215-879-7777**

**PRO-TIP: Utilize one of the city 's 10 satellite election offices to apply, complete, and return your mail-in ballot all at once. You can find a list of locations [HERE ONLINE](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15616).**
* * *
## **Voting in Person?**
* Figure out where you'll be voting before election day.
* You can [look up your polling place online](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100170807.173099.966&gen=1&mailing_linkid=15627) or call our office at **215-879-7777** if you need assistance
* Polls will be open on **November 4th from 7AM to 8PM**
* The busiest times to vote are in the morning and evening, so plan ahead or try going at a less busy time
* If this is your first time voting, you must bring a photo or non-photo ID

body:
Hi, it's Abigail Spanberger. I just got off the debate stage here in Norfolk, Virginia, and I wanted you to hear this from me personally:
Tonight was a milestone for our campaign.
And yes, the hour on stage with Winsome Earle-Sears will lead the headlines tomorrow. But this election is bigger than that. It's about the future of our Commonwealth.
From my days as a federal law enforcement officer and then as a CIA officer, I worked to keep our country safe. Then I ran for Congress not for the title, but to improve people's lives. And in this race, I've shown that I will put Virginia first — always.
Now, the whole country is placing their hope in this team to win the biggest election of 2025 so we can set the tone for 2026, 2028, and beyond.
That's why I hope I can earn your support tonight.
So, I'm asking one last time: Will you donate $25 to my campaign for Governor and Tim Kaine before midnight? It's going to take a lot more contributions to keep airing ads, mobilizing voters, and sharing our agenda. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-spanberger?amount=25]

# The Supreme Court Case that could change voting rights for generations
---
| |
[**What to know about the impact of this case.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=3e23e5a440&e=edbde6c9b1)

The Court will examine whether Louisiana’s court-ordered creation of a second majority-Black congressional district, drawn to fix a Voting Rights Act violation, is [unconstitutional](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=fa1f280254&e=edbde6c9b1) due to its consideration of race.
But at the heart of this case is **Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act** – the safeguard that protects voters of color from racially discriminatory political maps. For decades, Section 2 has been the central safeguard against racially discriminatory redistricting, requiring states to fix discriminatory maps so minority communities can have a fair chance to elect candidates of their choice.
The Supreme Court will now decide whether considering race to fix racial discrimination in political maps can itself be called “discrimination.” If the justices decide that remedies for discrimination violate the Constitution’s Equal Protection Clause, it would be a seismic shift – weaponizing the Reconstruction-era Amendments to dismantle the very rights they were created to protect.
If Section 2 is gutted, protections against discriminatory maps could nearly vanish nationwide. Courts have already given politicians a green light to gerrymander for partisan advantage. That means congressional districts, state legislative maps, city councils, even school boards could be redrawn in ways that silence entire communities.
---

📝****[**Sign this petition**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=aee91011a6&e=edbde6c9b1)**** to tell the Supreme Court and Congress you demand urgent action to defend voting rights.

My mom was diagnosed earlier this year, and because it was detected early they were able the swiftly act. She is doing fine, and we are grateful for the medical care she received!We hosted Spartanburg’s Sheriff-elect Bill Ryhne at our monthly party meeting on Monday and held an informative discussion around his vision for our community.
On Tuesday I attended the Art & Elections event hosted by Alix Refshauge and Cat Judice, highlighting female candidates running in Spartanburg County this year. It was so inspiring to hear from each candidate. And finally, I took a whirlwind trip to NYC, the place I called home for 16 years, to celebrate the Sister Senators big news - Actor Julianna Margulies has signed on as an executive producer! They had an incredible showing of support for their film, and received a matching $25,000 gift. Let's help them get this film to the finish line - support their efforts at [**https://www.sistersenatorsfilm.com.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=b51a0efb39&e=edbde6c9b1)
**Please call your Senators and tell them we won't stand for Senate Bill 323 that persecutes women, doctors, and even pastors.**[**Learn more here.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=b1c0632a62&e=edbde6c9b1)

body:
I wanted you to hear this from me personally:
#
Hi, it's Abigail Spanberger. I just got off the debate stage here in Norfolk, Virginia, and I wanted you to hear this from me personally:
_Tonight was a milestone for our campaign._
And yes, the hour on stage with Winsome Earle-Sears will lead the headlines tomorrow. But this election is bigger than that. _It's our only chance to flip a Governor's office blue this year and stand up to the chaos coming out of the Trump Administration._
From my days as a federal law enforcement officer and then as a CIA officer, I worked to keep our country safe. Then I ran for Congress not for the title, but to improve people's lives. And in this race, I've shown that I will put Virginia first — always.
Now, the whole country is placing their hope in this team to win the biggest election of 2025 so we can set the tone for 2026, 2028, and beyond.
**That's why I hope I can earn your support tonight.**
**[So, I'm asking one last time: Will you donate $5 to my campaign for Governor and State Democrats Committee before midnight? disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE REPUBLICAN PARTY OF WISCONSIN** NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE
body:
[](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qhtultl-didthutlhu-r/) Patriot, Liberal policies from Governor Evers and Sara Rodriguez threaten our way of life, but thanks to the tireless efforts of Republican legislators, we're scoring major victories for hardworking families like yours. From slashing taxes to protecting our freedoms, Wisconsin Republicans are delivering results, and [we need YOUR help](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qhtultl-didthutlhu-y/) to keep the momentum going!In the 2025-2027 State Budget, our GOP team blocked $3.7 billion in crushing tax hikes proposed by Democrats and instead delivered $1.5 billion in tax cuts over the next two years. That's real relief for Wisconsinites struggling with rising costs!We also reined in wasteful government spending by eliminating 300 vacant jobs, resulting in 1,200 fewer positions than Evers wanted, and continued a hiring freeze at the University of Wisconsin while ensuring faculty focus more on teaching our students, not bureaucracy.But that's not all. We're standing strong to defend Wisconsin values:
* We prevented dangerous welfare expansions and preserved drug-testing and work requirements for public assistance, promoting self-reliance over dependency.
* We blocked radical attacks on our Second Amendment rights, keeping your freedoms secure.
* We protected school choice and boosted funding for districts under Open Enrollment, giving parents more options for their kids' education.

[DEFEND OUR VALUES](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qhtultl-didthutlhu-j/) And the fight continues! Republicans in the State Assembly just introduced Assembly Bill 454 to create a Workforce Home Loan Program through WHEDA. This innovative plan offers first-time homebuyers up to $60,000 in 0% interest loans, making homeownership achievable for hardworking families.On our college campuses, where liberal indoctrination runs rampant, we're pushing back with a reintroduced bill to strengthen free speech protections. Students could sue UW System schools if their rights are violated - a crucial step after a 2023 UW survey revealed that over two-thirds of Republican students hide their views out of fear of lower grades or dismissal. Rep. Amanda Nedweski (R-Pleasant Prairie) nailed it: "With the recent assassination of conservative activist Charlie Kirk, we're hearing a lot more, particularly from college-age students, about the lack of viewpoint diversity on campuses."These wins don't happen by accident. They come from dedicated conservatives like YOU stepping up. But with elections on the horizon and liberals plotting their next move, we can't afford to let up. Your [donation today](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qhtultl-didthutlhu-d/) will fuel our efforts to keep Republican majorities, hold the line on taxes, and protect our values.Can we count on you? [**Chip in $25, $50, or $100 right now**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-qhtultl-didthutlhu-h/) to support Wisconsin Republicans and keep delivering for our state!Thank you for standing with us. name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is so good
body:
Even now... it still doesn’t feel real that we lost Charlie.

| | | [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zdrcuavragff2mktl5turefav3t3mjgit8o6oilo_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
Friend,Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction -- it shaped all of us.And his vision -- **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** -- is why Turning Point USA exists today.Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z8glhk9r6ee81ngnsftepdfbabcp1dd23cdd98to_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️To give you perspective, Friend...Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters.It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zd9aqe7ucmf0m01nppttmgj3k7ptshahst5cn5d8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
He always believed this day would come.He used to talk about it all the time -- how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America.And now... _It 's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible.And more beautiful than we can even describe.**Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _" What can I do?"_As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request.And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: **✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won 't be a small task. _ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here 's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zf9v2htu234gtkk8u9coir49lp4a46k770eu0aqo_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zi8c5rgj6orjeg3r4i93ao5j8m6svff1vt55tm40_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zcg594bc8gtoooekms605pmjqq31ttn6lujscjrg_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2za0nqdvbm38a25b6uql87ikt2729iq4bineo5udo_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zkmqd4l6qb9v0513ah3hhs5uiite351a2519jfb0_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zjmc0c9ksc7uluvj96m2dlgim8ee4vfvtoroaupo_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zo8fh8c5lfcf51tj1d4uoel83lvshgfpmv5bkcco_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
Also...**Here 's one more powerful thing you can do:**📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew -- or any young person in your life -- who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter...**Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zf74q6t70nuaqeb3l9hfq536b7uj7glf16unf538_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated...If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week...If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray...**Thank you.** We can never say it enough.If you've read this far, we want you to know this...**You 're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come. **God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers.Charlie would have wanted you to pray first -- and if that's all you can give today, _we 're grateful._But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor...And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible.**Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z06raqf5gpqe6cudq03jukoo89rbueffi1sp9qq0_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1ie8pj4c3h2bs)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend.**God is so good.** 🙏
---

Phoenix, Arizona 85044

## Gazans, Israelis Celebrate Ceasefire Deal
Israelis and Gazans alike celebrated in the streets on Thursday, chanting President Trump’s name after he brokered a cease-fire aimed at ending the two-year war in Gaza. [See photos here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O4zAMRk8jdwok-i8uVGyjLttuaSgWbXMhS4bEJEhOP9DMEQZk94hH8vt3m2-OAsXtrzvQ8JrmiK8SkBnzfJBHV3jBgPfsmFKshJhmUNBLraRWs3cU3nPXeLMiArYNGj0OSk2qn9pmN4PS12Xqpn50XdtfO30fVt8OtSe4rktDptq0qqVaDZdxBN330zCq1utVe9Ep9MQpX_4nirzjGt7pifmypKMJZmc-i2j_CLACbHyfqXBFAmwVC7BaCbBqEmAfRdb_BNjNfVwsshollewwUJEU5bK7yBQ3yflxnEVGd6Cs2-SCrqBcKaOM6Y5Bnpk-KDn9jAqwTTb-fFEIVIZRdGo7HIXvK_lX0T4NfAUAAP__eWGM6g). Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction -- it shaped all of us. And his vision -- **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** -- is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyMkbGO2zAMQL9G3hxIlGOdBw9FAwMd7taOAkUxjnCW5Epyiv59kTRDxwMXgo_kA8Gf7_YdwxbS-oGRZ7oHW6pdsw-15jVnb0HCuVeyV9LuJdedqVnV-Zn8qKHjWZlRyklpbbrbPHlPipwDvprJjQ7lOCEOYMyVpJpkF-bHPiWfcdbDifEMRmmnHE3OwZsY5LF7bFxPlFPlcscW7hxSyo8spxPl2G3zrbW9Cv1NwCJgqUxH4RMm9rk9OgQs7SgppLXfc0itPyoKWCbJno0Z--swUj8MMPXISvbaSckEGvHtLPRS81GILWXPQl--__gwMCgpYDxatJF9OKLQF44Ytlfx34TQlxsWj_XTIv16IcK4Y1iT0Bf6tBuvSH9eqHGJ_wm6Mvv9d9i2UEcjBrk-BM9729c_c5_hbwAAAP__eGCYIA)

**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyMkbGO2zAMQL9G3hxIlGOdBw9FAwMd7taOAkUxjnCW5Epyiv59kTRDxwMXgo_kA8Gf7_YdwxbS-oGRZ7oHW6pdsw-15jVnb0HCuVeyV9LuJdedqVnV-Zn8qKHjWZlRyklpbbrbPHlPipwDvprJjQ7lOCEOYMyVpJpkF-bHPiWfcdbDifEMRmmnHE3OwZsY5LF7bFxPlFPlcscW7hxSyo8spxPl2G3zrbW9Cv1NwCJgqUxH4RMm9rk9OgQs7SgppLXfc0itPyoKWCbJno0Z--swUj8MMPXISvbaSckEGvHtLPRS81GILWXPQl--__gwMCgpYDxatJF9OKLQF44Ytlfx34TQlxsWj_XTIv16IcK4Y1iT0Bf6tBuvSH9eqHGJ_wm6Mvv9d9i2UEcjBrk-BM9729c_c5_hbwAAAP__eGCYIA)

He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time -- how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It 's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _" What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started -- including: ** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won 't be a small task. _ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here 's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit -- ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?

## Roberson Execution Stayed
Next week's scheduled execution of Robert Roberson, convicted of murdering his 2-year-old daughter Nikki in 2003, was [stayed yesterday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGO5CAMhp8m6TwCQiApUlwz3V57ZWTATNAyEAGzmbz9KXvSvcBWlmzps77___OxfmCIIT1-45OW9vZ5TXTUSK1RWelN9tVCTrXhSe4Z7EYxpE9aBRMjcAacrQ5DPFfZu8UwN_OeFq4VY7Nk09xvyzho5ifmlBhHq0ZBjo9CM6OMUKRp7sNywTjjjHPGxXTTs5cD89ooqY121ElGLrRcbm2jRm-sPp75i8rN5mcfl621vXbDr07cO3E_juN2eMTr2Ik7lhZspE7c65lcsHjpXPtasw3YyO2Fau3E_ZsMuO-EsYLNr9IAHxgS7PiqVOF_GpA9lGyotH-j5gQhQd3wkxIYNCdYrNdPxRUMw6AH5yyg9CPISWhArhRI7b2ahDYTm_uyuP0IMYaqdCfZ44khfuu1n5XytYi_AQAA__9icqGJ) by the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals. It's the third time his execution has been blocked. The order cited a stay of execution in a similar case last October, when a [new trial was ordered](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO6yAQRb8Gd1gzBJtQULzGXV67pQVmiNFiExkSO3-_cor9ga1miqtzde7XbbzZmOJ6_28XMvUIeVxpL4lqpW2kg6ZnjXkt1b7JL3GaKcX1m0YBouMIHGH0Nqb3KBtvHHiNDRlUPYCWcNXNbFBap1W4ik5LmACBUIpO9052pNGFJpoThoCACCiurdJBXiAo10vllCcmgXyseWvrTJUOW0J65xdt7ZSXJpm51kdhl39MDEwM-763IR_y1DgDTAzny8SwZUdb5Z9T8lr4h8V_JfnDPgt5bu82rs1m_GOPKcXSKybhvtiYPoX1bzO9jPgJAAD__2FYfic) for a Dallas County man convicted of injuring a child on a diagnosis of shaken baby syndrome, which has come under intense scrutiny in recent years. Roberson's case was [remanded to a district court](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u2zAMhZ9G3mRQvP6JBg1dtN2uHQ3ZomIhshVITJy8feEU7Qt04vCB5PnOr-_p28UU9-tPt5HhV8jTTkdNxExlohctD455r-ze5Le4rJTifqMJAXupQCqYvIvpPXWNNzN4rRoyahwAdAcX3aymX3RACIuG4Hsfeue0o0vvsMNhDKSaaM5jChQoBQov7ahD9wVhnIdunEdPogPykXNpeSWml6shvfOTSrvkrUlmZb5X8fVDoBVoj-Nob9XxCQXa00ag_awJtOcrgVaBQAv6L5BLfhSWc8rLrcp_1jIH6cnxKks-ZNw3xyRLnqnwn1HzLtA2xfj7EVOKdRhFB9fNxfTJxv_X6NPg7wAAAP__Gj2LqQ) in Anderson County for consideration of new evidence that could clear him of wrongdoing. Roberson and his legal team insist Nikki died from complications of chronic pneumonia and a fall from her bed. State Rep. Jeff Leach (R-Plano), whose legislative committee orchestrated a last-minute stay of Roberson's execution last year, [praised](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGuoyAYRp8GdxhAq2XBohszyaQzy1kahM9KitAA1vbtJ_Ym9wXu6l_8ycl3zr_reNXOu3D7o1eo8prjGLBnj1KQRrxgtuJiyEW_YVdnFngX7hgFEyfKGeVstNr599hWVk3MSl5B8b5jTLbsLKtFQTbyJE9G2LbpYLkR6PVsRSN1I4Fz5dQB44wzzhkX57qXc9uwuZ-6tp96C9IyWFdiqsuCgpfOs3_HJ1Jt4lp5tZTyyKS5EDEQMez7Xq85HD8iBgS6ZSKGQ4qIwSS3gojhQ6EmbqnQW9KhZJrihFS-To6BHso0zvS7Ad2BO50wxwSazQK7eVhqdTmIOtHLhf-Vv38NVVL2sTvvXe560rLbqp3_bC0_K_xU4n8AAAD__xySksk) the decision, saying "truth and justice finally win the day." Others, including pediatricians at UT Austin and Yale School of Medicine, maintain that Roberson [was responsible](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO8yAQBeDT4M7WgIkJBcXf0OVvt7TAjGMUbCKYxMntV85Ke4Gtphjpe3rv6zJeXExxu_53Kxp6zXnccK8JibCM-MLpQTFvldwbwxqnBVPcbjgKEKeWQ8thDC6m9yibYDwEzRs0XA0AWsJZN4sRPASOA_ZeS3dSfX-S3g-TE9MsNYBrojkwDhw4By7OndKz7GFWfpDKq4BMAoZIuXS0IOHL1Tm98xNLN-W1SWYhulfW_2PCMmH3fe9uiZ7Hkwl72ExYDkxY0EzYD9BO-VGoXVyi2v62bEv2WOjn1LwxYZtiwn2PKcU6KCbhurqYPrn0t7WeRnwHAAD__-Rvflw) for Nikki's death.
## Residents Aim to Regulate Crypto Mine
About 250 residents in Hood County will vote on [whether to incorporate](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAYhJ8GO8wPq6IFxTV2e-2VBuVnIQeywX9XffuL-wo31SSTfJOZn_t0NyGG9fFtEmo6XJ5W3LeIRFgmPHB5UcjrRuZEm8LiMYb1FycJsuUCuIDJmhDPqamsnsEOokItVAcwNNAPldd9O5tBirmVpped6p1Y5NC21preqdnIKugLJkCAECBkX6vBNTdwau4aNSuLrAG0gXKpySPhYTYXz_zGUi85VVF7oufGbl9MjkyO-77Xp_E5XymT4zWHydEUCkvEy665kOcfEF9ySq810MnfmZC7XBIXcOnWqtpTilXR9rmHGMPWKdbAI5kQP830v7_eWv4FAAD__57Hf_g) their rural community into the city of Mitchell Bend to address noise pollution from a nearby cryptocurrency mining facility. Built in 2022, the MARA Holdings facility is one of four the company operates in Texas, which accounts for about 40% of the nation’s crypto mines. # The Supreme Court Case that could change voting rights for generations
---
| |
[**What to know about the impact of this case.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=9bb695f36c&e=edbde6c9b1)

The Court will examine whether Louisiana’s court-ordered creation of a second majority-Black congressional district, drawn to fix a Voting Rights Act violation, is [unconstitutional](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=16e412a57c&e=edbde6c9b1) due to its consideration of race.
But at the heart of this case is **Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act** – the safeguard that protects voters of color from racially discriminatory political maps. For decades, Section 2 has been the central safeguard against racially discriminatory redistricting, requiring states to fix discriminatory maps so minority communities can have a fair chance to elect candidates of their choice.
The Supreme Court will now decide whether considering race to fix racial discrimination in political maps can itself be called “discrimination.” If the justices decide that remedies for discrimination violate the Constitution’s Equal Protection Clause, it would be a seismic shift – weaponizing the Reconstruction-era Amendments to dismantle the very rights they were created to protect.
If Section 2 is gutted, protections against discriminatory maps could nearly vanish nationwide. Courts have already given politicians a green light to gerrymander for partisan advantage. That means congressional districts, state legislative maps, city councils, even school boards could be redrawn in ways that silence entire communities.
---

📝****[**Sign this petition**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=d3d9559e9c&e=edbde6c9b1)**** to tell the Supreme Court and Congress you demand urgent action to defend voting rights.

Last Friday I was honored to attend the Be Her Champions event raising awareness about Breast Cancer with the Spartanburg Regional Foundation. My mom was diagnosed earlier this year, and because it was detected early they were able the swiftly act. She is doing fine, and we are grateful for the medical care she received!We hosted Spartanburg’s Sheriff-elect Bill Ryhne at our monthly party meeting on Monday and held an informative discussion around his vision for our community.
On Tuesday I attended the Art & Elections event hosted by Alix Refshauge and Cat Judice, highlighting female candidates running in Spartanburg County this year. It was so inspiring to hear from each candidate. subject: JOIN US: Bill McKibben and others on what we do now to support clean energy
body:
Defending and delivering clean energy progress in every community
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4078985/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
|
## **⚡EVENT ALERT⚡**
Federal home energy tax credits are expiring soon and utility-scale clean energy projects are stalling, which means the next few months will be critical for our clean energy transition.

To learn more about what advocates and local decision-makers can do, **join Evergreen next Thursday, October 16 for**[** _Powering Forward: Defending and Delivering Clean Energy in Every Community_**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4078986/87SdQ4wZ): a conversation with Bill McKibben, Rewiring America, and Greenlight America about what’s needed now. [RSVP](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4078987/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Hi there,

The transition to a thriving clean energy future is at a crossroads. Across the country, families are wiring their homes for a cleaner, cheaper future while neighbors are working together to bring larger clean energy projects to life in their communities.

At the same time, Trump’s disastrous budget law is eliminating tax credits that make this clean energy switch affordable, and many federal incentives for these projects have new deadlines that expire soon.

To learn more about what’s at stake and what opportunities for progress still exist at the state level, please join me **next Thursday, October 16, at 12 p.m. ET / 9 a.m. PT** for a conversation with _Here Comes the Sun_ author Bill McKibben and the founders of Rewiring America and Greenlight America. We’ll talk about what state leaders and advocates can do right now to power our clean energy future. [**Can you make it?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4078988/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[YES, COUNT ME IN](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4078989/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| **During this panel-style conversation, you’ll learn:**
* What homeowners, renters, and advocates can do before the federal rebate window closes.
* How state and local leaders can sustain momentum with new programs and policies.
* Why local clean energy projects are stalling—and how to change this.
* Where decision-makers and advocates can work together to keep the clean energy transition moving.

|
---
| We’ll also have plenty of time for Q&A and will share the recording afterwards.

**The next few months will be decisive for how fast our nation’s clean energy progress accelerates or stalls** —and as we know, speed is everything when it comes to tackling the climate crisis. [**I hope you’ll join me next Thursday for this important conversation.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4078990/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[RSVP TODAY](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4078991/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| In solidarity, |
---
| | |
---
### Lena Moffitt
Executive Director
Evergreen Collaborative

The MAGA attempt to take over the Pennsylvania Supreme Court is not as publicized as the January 6th insurrection or Musk's involvement in Wisconsin earlier this year.
Their tactics are evolving: This plan is far more behind the scenes. In fact: It's a whisper.
Donald Trump and his MAGA allies aren't storming statehouses this time. They aren't bragging on cable news or staging rallies to show off their plans. They've learned that noise only wakes Democrats up.
So now they're trying something new: a silent coup.
Here's how it works. Three Democratic justices on Pennsylvania's Supreme Court face retention this November. If voters say "No," MAGA takes the majority. From there, they can gerrymander congressional districts into deep red safe seats, rubber-stamp Trump's agenda, and rewrite the rules of our democracy before the 2026 midterms and the 2028 presidential election.
Their plan is simple: keep the race out of the headlines, keep Democrats at home, and quietly buy themselves the most important court in the country.
That's what makes this coup so dangerous. It doesn't look like chaos. It looks like silence.
Defend Our Courts refuses to stay quiet. We're pounding the pavement with canvassers, running targeted ads, and alerting voters to what's at stake. But going up against MAGA's billionaire bankroll is no small feat.

Patriot, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
| [ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=58c4382d082f44bb89e3b244dc9ddbd4&_e=lS1yIlfQn60ZwxxlYs40rJLn3rPWpJioXZ96TGE_wA1fcXvU-HeM4_MgCFB63-1xOmk2QZoUmRS8pU3imKU2e3Q5T77HwHs7spB3YijHwlAVjGH3NM33rfkqXAKQenJliKthFoQAxdVuGrc42xKvpGqKnwF5Ux2z5RJ8_wT4uadUuSYaA0Ick3MRKAWpm9x_VVCKOFPzXBpLaHXENj_bXfl_g8WDna6nbFGvEsjts3p8gWuvU6mK6urcsm1NKjv5Su-MSztRKcGyejqJzTcVE7VvamRQzQlA1-TqafPc6XEHd5_uuoplAStyXdXzjxQsWU6iaC854dQmO1IYMN2qWD9j_tai8CguIqs6yndEC2uLCSFVd6tBu2Tl01UpUE9AExLAGFhQxUHXZERoQqwJ9k0kAD3CKCWFR-f3Crijbn_ZLllTNS8HAsFW_A3OqEY4YTj9NygCvOrJCvH4FkI5GkoTilYB4FQiy_QN2Rk1ijN_GRDeAuPABVeFCxL1zRcrxkhbYZAT1sxWdJpBPkWr5RgKVVNjVAoDuPhd1qLCvQH2dQ-Z5_17Q7tY4ynGDeRptSXfWLrRf0b0QJgbINfN1-AKodhcrn0l_-GD3z3PbiD00rEZEkH__d5MMlUdmoUiWwPJY4bdWm8ldcz8x4PkyxKCA8ZYitN_tVhA96eXpR-t2xXfle7wtERY4bF2RM0HVqg4X7TmMy9K2TGHvSuY7Q%3D%3D)

_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
| [ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=58c4382d082f44bb89e3b244dc9ddbd4&_e=lS1yIlfQn60ZwxxlYs40rJLn3rPWpJioXZ96TGE_wA1fcXvU-HeM4_MgCFB63-1xOmk2QZoUmRS8pU3imKU2e3Q5T77HwHs7spB3YijHwlAVjGH3NM33rfkqXAKQenJliKthFoQAxdVuGrc42xKvpGqKnwF5Ux2z5RJ8_wT4uadUuSYaA0Ick3MRKAWpm9x_VVCKOFPzXBpLaHXENj_bXfl_g8WDna6nbFGvEsjts3p8gWuvU6mK6urcsm1NKjv5Nw1STwaQyromuZhcmUjtfdTeHdu-xk2IfgeB9IgvlwgVKMDbsQ480eR5PcnqwGJPWJGWYulNHfG-rGsOZJRO2aPMK-JeQrUpsVe3-POMT4aj-FhDTFb2GRQ8i7VkBJdcTLrxHaZwBipsMVBWz0LERjmemT5S0IxZOXecgrY3_FBrS8lLKtmDz3l9TwCDQaPw5U6wjsWZLyDsjEBDXczjZK16lCKYglekDF1gRwaHqh-9mw2hZpEIj7DWcvfwSepoaBTTQ5gesWSwshE_iA53IKbXiejk9AzXf7DC-rpq8ptrEo5us8s6T6C5gEE7erg0KJFJL1wcG--IwaXwOuyulpDu2RgeD-pjsWbeDk_QhdVBT7-cWAR6qFxqlB2GLyujtSe5i5k3c8v3WUNow0c5yUT7Jxk-TCzSZB3icF6alXNjYwUSfxQ6OR1xGIN_IsonkLVs9gnkS8KiyApHQct0cw%3D%3D)

We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _
| [ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=58c4382d082f44bb89e3b244dc9ddbd4&_e=lS1yIlfQn60ZwxxlYs40rJLn3rPWpJioXZ96TGE_wA1fcXvU-HeM4_MgCFB63-1xOmk2QZoUmRS8pU3imKU2e3Q5T77HwHs7spB3YijHwlAVjGH3NM33rfkqXAKQenJliKthFoQAxdVuGrc42xKvpGqKnwF5Ux2z5RJ8_wT4uadUuSYaA0Ick3MRKAWpm9x_VVCKOFPzXBpLaHXENj_bXfl_g8WDna6nbFGvEsjts3p8gWuvU6mK6urcsm1NKjv5FO1_Vkac1VAZaJkF1391PaxAHhN_gFbyxfTBBwClSUGpF49DhbjqV7BVr4i3qNBYO1NJMbLUbtHNcwvwEagYBamGIg3-_W_vyYxqsgFJ8T90lsG49sUeHdNvTWbBjdBWR09MnsTqGrfFM5RK5Zynwjvq6qTjrsOW-DLiRiS75hJDnjkHxQq6mUflGrBa9XUSFC6DjGtzdEGXXVF4HOFv06owOegHtuhfs-fSm-TwlYPgP0iVyqFeGh1IHmGhfkIqGwS5hr58fxqIIRhRFeIOIx532FziwpSCpo3c5nvRknx_EProp5VyIxDfZFffc1XzOR9BauEQEsOLWR1EZVL1BbVh5aY1XwpyrQfSZJjgqoNXlr9xmvZ6lSywtjJ6_WUAo9WktyB6brg7PpVtUH2YatK4-67CPdQdt4-ZkPBAuIe7GO9uavOjSMYWdIpTCQSIYsm6-fxkbzjdFYBJmw4tpg%3D%3D)

_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Patriot, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**

Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work.
**For Charlie.** **God Bless,** **Tyler Bowyer**

clean_body: “You’ve gotta meet this guy in Illinois...” A tribute to Charlie & Turning Point Action—see how to help and double your impact today. | | Patriot, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, " You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois." So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving. | Above: The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... I knew. Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. Faith, family, freedom -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? He did it. He didn't just build a brand... He built a machine. First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it from the start. Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together. | We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- and it delivered real results. 10 for 10. In every single state we operated in... Trump won. In Arizona alone, we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. In Wisconsin? 60,000+. In Nevada? 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. In Michigan? 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... We made history. | Above: Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. Because Charlie never stopped. He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- and make it stronger than ever. Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- we must turn it into action. He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: " What are we building next?" Well, Patriot, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time. | But it doesn 't happen without you. So, here 's my ask... Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work. For Charlie. God Bless, Tyler Bowyer Chief Operating Officer Turning Point Action P.S. I would give anything to have Charlie back. But he left us with something powerful -- a machine that works... a machine that's proven and battle-tested. Now it's time to run it -- and run it like never before. Bigger. Bolder. More battlegrounds. More victories. Because right now, thanks to a generous supporter of Turning Point Action, your gift will be matched dollar-for-dollar -- up to $500,000, through October 31. That means, with your gift today: ✅ 2X the activists trained ✅ 2X the voters registered ✅ 2X the pressure on weak-kneed politicians ✅ 2X the ballot-chasing operations ✅ 2X the grassroots strength the Left can't stop We don't need to reinvent anything. Charlie already drew the blueprint and turned the key. So, if you've been wondering how to help... If you've been asking " what now?" Then, Patriot, this is your moment to step in, fuel the fight, and take Charlie 's vision to the next level. Let's turn this energy -- this momentum -- into action. | Peter,
After the embarrassing public breakup with Elon Musk earlier this year, Donald Trump has already found his new billionaire rebound--meet Jeff Yass, Pennsylvania's richest man and Trump's new sugar daddy.
Jeff Yass is a Wall Street gambler turned MAGA kingmaker, a billionaire who made his fortune playing the markets and is a major investor in TikTok's parent company, ByteDance. In 2024, he spent over $46 million dollars supporting MAGA candidates in elections across the country.
And now, Yass is trying to buy Trump his biggest gift wish of 2025: the Pennsylvania Supreme Court.
---
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GIxSwjJy6p8_40M33rmuNQKkq16fbkYj_RbGV4A3SvJWV8nIO0Puv5jmg7hkNjAbr-EY_25cfhxZcu3Ubbf61kZwx5AWxMsk6YyZHfZ9jboTfp2YaDkvrLdSj_YoC4QbAdNaLkZ2aC05Td4m38HUpDaMmh7k0GC70TqXxTOLWoHEp30ET_TDiQoC8XY8A9tziLBuS3oUNS9DKK6CL47J69sfBMARx4eZub1c6yVeSlA=&c=p0QU8CBpEy4Bd8D0oasMuXzmAwuBU1r86EqJKNF6amtKsv3s_ywGhg==&ch=Y5_WP4NSB1XqaEoYaIpUCGGH4IzstCuabZk-yWBwgQ2j6LgocZGPSA==)
---
The PA Supreme Court retention race is the most important race of 2025 and we aren't exaggerating when we say Democracy itself is on the line here.
If Yass' spending successfully topples the court's three vote liberal majority next month, he'll give Trump control of the body overseeing elections in the most important swing state for the upcoming '26 and '28 elections. Trump will then outlaw mail-in ballots, prevent Democratic ballots from being counted, and may even ban Democrats from appearing on ballots altogether. Trump's new sugar daddy has reportedly committed to spending over $30 million dollars in this election and Yass connected dark money organizations launched a massive surprise spending spree in PA--flooding the zone with advertisements attacking the Democratic Justices and even using dirty tricks to try and fool voters:
---
| | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GIxSwjJy6p8_40M33rmuNQKkq16fbkYj_RbGV4A3SvJWV8nIO0Puv5jmg7hkNjAbr-EY_25cfhxZcu3Ubbf61kZwx5AWxMsk6YyZHfZ9jboTfp2YaDkvrLdSj_YoC4QbAdNaLkZ2aC05Td4m38HUpDaMmh7k0GC70TqXxTOLWoHEp30ET_TDiQoC8XY8A9tziLBuS3oUNS9DKK6CL47J6_mnluv6T_BmXPpusrhpItg=&c=p0QU8CBpEy4Bd8D0oasMuXzmAwuBU1r86EqJKNF6amtKsv3s_ywGhg==&ch=Y5_WP4NSB1XqaEoYaIpUCGGH4IzstCuabZk-yWBwgQ2j6LgocZGPSA==)
---
Earlier this summer, having caught wind of this incoming coup attempt, Defend Our Courts launched a desperate call to democrats from across the nation to come to PA's aid. Having now raised nearly 3 million dollars from over 50,000 donors, we are one of the largest organizations pushing back against Yass' attempts to buy this election.
But with only 25 days left in the election, we are still being outspent by Yass' dark money organizations 10 to 1. If the election were held today, Yass would likely succeed in buying the court. But if Democrats rally now like we did earlier this year to stop Elon Musk in Wisconsin, we can defeat Trump's new sugar daddy.

If Yass' spending successfully topples the court's three vote liberal majority next month, he'll give Trump control of the body overseeing elections in the most important swing state for the upcoming '26 and '28 elections. Trump will then outlaw mail-in ballots, prevent Democratic ballots from being counted, and may even ban Democrats from appearing on ballots altogether. Trump's new sugar daddy has reportedly committed to spending over $30 million dollars in this election and Yass connected dark money organizations launched a massive surprise spending spree in PA--flooding the zone with advertisements attacking the Democratic Justices and even using dirty tricks to try and fool voters: | | == Earlier this summer, having caught wind of this incoming coup attempt, Defend Our Courts launched a desperate call to democrats from across the nation to come to PA's aid. Having now raised nearly 3 million dollars from over 50,000 donors, we are one of the largest organizations pushing back against Yass' attempts to buy this election. But with only 25 days left in the election, we are still being outspent by Yass' dark money organizations 10 to 1. If the election were held today, Yass would likely succeed in buying the court. But if Democrats rally now like we did earlier this year to stop Elon Musk in Wisconsin, we can defeat Trump's new sugar daddy. == | | | | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | == | == | == | | == | == | == | | | | == We can't let Yass buy this court, or democracy itself could fall. name: Tim Holbert, American Veterans Center
subject: 250 years of American valor with your free American flag
body:
For more than two decades, American Veterans Center has been dedicated to honoring the sacrifice and preserving the legacy of our nation’s heroes.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn6ngp1cnj4ar07j14gujhqa5ld5rmmniv227noo_rp22sh2s8i6eor0chi6aor4cph2bs)
---
Friend, For more than two decades, American Veterans Center has been dedicated to honoring the sacrifice and preserving the legacy of our nation's heroes. Each year, we host the **National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** , bringing Americans together in a powerful display of remembrance and patriotism. We also proudly produce **" American Valor: A Salute to Our Heroes,"** a nationally televised tribute to the men and women who have served across generations.

But our work goes far beyond public events. At the heart of our mission is a commitment to **preserve the stories of veterans from every era of service** -- from the final voices of World War II, to those who served in Korea, Vietnam, and the post-9/11 generation. Through these efforts, we ensure that future generations understand the cost of freedom and the courage it has taken to defend it.

This year, American Veterans Center is marking historic military milestones: the 250th anniversaries of the U.S. Army, Navy, and Marine Corps...the 80th anniversary of the victories that won World War II...and key events in the Korean War 75 years ago, and the Vietnam War which ended 50 years ago this year.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo6g3n5u20ld62pn3ecv3i4fnh0bh4vio3u8v4f0_rp22sh2s8i6eor0chi6aor4cph2bs)
---
**We may never have another opportunity like this to recognize their sacrifice on a national scale.**

[**To mark the occasion, I want to send you a full-size (3x5ft) American flag when you make a gift of $25, $50, $100 or more to support the American Veterans Center 's historic campaign: American Honor 2025.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znljv24osbiba9ovo8cueicpa1usb3op7a65gp10_rp22sh2s8i6eor0chi6aor4cph2bs)
---
[ **Claim Your FREE Flag Today**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfgp2vn1cqj92ou0eoi9da5lmcmb2u72s08edvno_rp22sh2s8i6eor0chi6aor4cph2bs)
---
This is one of our most ambitious efforts ever, Friend -- a national salute to those who fought to make and keep America free.

**Together, we 're capturing the stories of WWII veterans before it's too late...and preserving seldom-heard accounts from those who fought in Korea, Vietnam, and the post-9/11 wars.**

And with your gift today, I'll send you a free, full-size American flag as my thank you.

To some, it may look like just a flag.

_But to those who served, it 's a promise kept._

It flew over the beaches of Normandy.

It sailed with the Pacific fleet.

It was stitched into the sleeves of every soldier who never made it home.

**This flag reminds us of all they sacrificed, and what we 're now called to defend.**

Let it fly proudly as a reminder that freedom isn't free -- and that this generation will not forget the sacrifices of the last.

[**So please, Friend, make your gift today. Help us preserve their legacy while there's still time -- and proudly fly the flag they fought for.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlb6smsvd7q9e5531cf05nbcsjqkfchebd7gcct8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0chi6aor4cph2bs)
---
[ **Claim Your Free Flag Today**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpjhca339fli8gpf0mrneru38j237591cmvdirm0_rp22sh2s8i6eor0chi6aor4cph2bs)
---
Friend, throughout American history, our nation's flag has stood tall.

**I hope you 'll take this opportunity to receive your American flag and fly it proudly, today and every day as a symbol AND promise of freedom.**

Thank you for standing with America's heroes -- past, present, and future.
---
Sincerely,

Tim Holbert
President
American Veterans Center
---
[ **Support the American Veterans Center**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdm961aafcv8nkf9t1dfa1gs4h64f3dik2ks3i3g_rp22sh2s8i6eor0chi6aor4cph2bs)
---

name: Mark Kelly
subject: It’s not an easy decision to make
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Gabby and I both knew we couldn’t just sit on the sidelines as our country went further and further down the wrong path. We had to do something.
#

Hey folks. It’s Mark Kelly.
I want to talk through a difficult decision I had to make about six years ago.
We were a few years into Donald Trump’s first term, and Mitch McConnell was the Senate Majority Leader. Gabby and I both knew we couldn’t just sit on the sidelines as our country went further and further down the wrong path. We had to do something.
So, together, we decided to launch a campaign for Arizona’s seat in the U.S. Senate. I didn’t know if I could win, or if anyone would support me, and I had no idea if my team would be able to raise the resources we’d need to win.
But one by one, people came on board. $5 here, $10 there. More than a million people donated and volunteered to help me, and in November of 2020, we won that campaign.
Around that same time, Jon Ossoff was making a similar decision. He went on to win one of the closest, toughest, most expensive races in the country down in Georgia. Over the last several years, it’s been an honor to work beside him in the Senate. Jon’s been a constant ally, and I’m proud to call him a friend.
He’s up for re-election next year, he’s in for an incredibly tough fight, and it’s absolutely critical that he wins. To do it, we all need to help.

subject: “We took the freedom of speech away”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
The President of the United States used those exact words in a public meeting at the White House yesterday.
#
“We took the freedom of speech away.”
That isn’t a quote from Kim Jong Un, or Vladimir Putin, or Xi Jinping.
The President of the United States used those exact words in a public meeting at the White House this week.
"We took the freedom of speech away, because that's been through the courts, and the courts said you have freedom of speech, but what has happened is when they burn a flag it agitates and irritates crowds."
Look — we love the American flag. We honor it. We very proudly put it on our shirts, hats, and other gear because of all it represents. We’d never think of burning it and do not support those who do.
But no matter how each of us feels about it, burning the American flag is still an act of Constitutionally protected free speech. It’s been decided multiple times by the Supreme Court. We don’t have to like it, but we’d die to protect that right because that’s what it means to support the Constitution. And that’s the oath we took.
The fact that a President of the United States is bragging about “taking the freedom of speech away” isn’t front-page news should be disturbing every single one of us. There should be universal condemnation. It should end his presidency. But the MAGA sycophants in Congress won’t do a thing to stop him, even as he shreds our rights in broad daylight.
Now, all of that might be true, and it may seem especially bleak, but we can’t have you lose hope. We have not, and we will not. Every person on the VoteVets team wakes up ready to go toe-to-toe with Trump and his goons.
This country, our Constitution, and our democracy – and free speech for all – are worth fighting for.
And if you are still with us, please:

While Trump’s health care crisis is causing millions of Americans to face massive cost increases due to Trump’s Big Ugly Bill, Democrats are fighting to pass a bipartisan budget that keeps the government open and ensures families can afford health care coverage.

**In contrast, Mike Johnson is calling Democrats’ stance to defend healthcare a “wild wish list, a big government liberal nonsense.”**

You can’t make this stuff up.

We are in the second week of the shutdown because Republicans refuse to fund health care. Due to their efforts to impose huge cuts to Medicaid, Medicare, and the Affordable Care Act, 500,000 Ohioans may see their premiums skyrocket, in some cases doubling, and millions more nationwide will feel the impact. That’s unacceptable.

**To make matters worse, Speaker Johnson canceled ALL votes this week, and we haven’t had a House vote since _September 19th._** Republicans are hiding. They’re not showing up to do their job. And Americans are paying the price.

This is a mess made by Republicans, and Democrats are trying to clean it up. I vow to keep fighting to reopen the government and lower costs for Americans.

In solidarity,

As she enters her second full term in Congress, she will use that experience to continue the fight for affordable quality health care, jobs that pay fair wages, a strong public education system, and to preserve and protect our democracy for generations to come. Will you join her and be the change we need?

| Friend,
After the embarrassing public breakup with Elon Musk earlier this year, Donald Trump has already found his new billionaire rebound--meet Jeff Yass, Pennsylvania's richest man and Trump's new sugar daddy.
Jeff Yass is a Wall Street gambler turned MAGA kingmaker, a billionaire who made his fortune playing the markets and is a major investor in TikTok's parent company, ByteDance. In 2024, he spent over $46 million dollars supporting MAGA candidates in elections across the country.
And now, Yass is trying to buy Trump his biggest gift wish of 2025: the Pennsylvania Supreme Court.
---

If Yass' spending successfully topples the court's three vote liberal majority next month, he'll give Trump control of the body overseeing elections in the most important swing state for the upcoming '26 and '28 elections. Trump will then outlaw mail-in ballots, prevent Democratic ballots from being counted, and may even ban Democrats from appearing on ballots altogether.
Trump's new sugar daddy has reportedly committed to spending over $30 million dollars in this election and Yass connected dark money organizations launched a massive surprise spending spree in PA--flooding the zone with advertisements attacking the Democratic Justices and even using dirty tricks to try and fool voters:

Earlier this summer, having caught wind of this incoming coup attempt, Defend Our Courts launched a desperate call to democrats from across the nation to come to PA's aid. Having now raised nearly 3 million dollars from over 50,000 donors, we are one of the largest organizations pushing back against Yass' attempts to buy this election.
But with only 25 days left in the election, we are still being outspent by Yass' dark money organizations 10 to 1. If the election were held today, Yass would likely succeed in buying the court. But if Democrats rally now like we did earlier this year to stop Elon Musk in Wisconsin, we can defeat Trump's new sugar daddy.

name: Danielle Bethell for Governor
subject: Oregonians still have a voice. We’re about to use it
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Danielle Bethell PAC 20220 [Preferences](https://daniellebethell
body:
Oregonians get the final say.
[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-r/) Friends,There's a moment in Oregon history that I've been thinking about this week.In 1902, our state became one of the first in America to give power back to the people -- the power to challenge laws passed by politicians through what's called a _referendum._ Since the 1920s, we have a proud tradition of reversing tax increases through referendum.For more than a century since, when leaders have gone too far, the people have stepped up and said, _enough._**That 's what we're doing again now.****Governor Kotek and her allies just passed a $4.3 billion package of new taxes and fees** : higher gas taxes, higher registration costs, and a doubled payroll tax on workers. Families who are already stretched thin are being told once again to pay for Salem's mistakes.But this time, **Oregonians get the final say.** [Make Your Voice Heard](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-y/) A new referendum effort will bring these tax hikes straight to the voters. It's being led by people who believe, like I do, that Oregon's comeback starts with accountability, not endless tax increases.Serving as Marion County Commissioner, I've helped balance budgets, delivered wildfire recovery funds, and keep deputies on the job _without raising taxes._ **I know what it takes to make government live within its means. That 's what leadership looks like.****It 's also why I'm running for governor.**Oregon doesn't need more politicians passing the buck, it needs someone who's actually led through tough times, made hard calls, and delivered real results. I'm running to be your Republican nominee because I believe Oregon can work again for the people who live and work here, not just for those who run the system.This referendum is bigger than one bill. **_It 's about whether Oregon still belongs to the people or to the political machine that's been running it for forty years._**I know which side I'm on.You can be part of it, too. Sign up below to pledge your support, volunteer, or donate to help gather signatures. Let's remind one-party rule Progressives that direct democracy is still alive and well, and that Oregon's voice is stronger than ever. [Get in the Fight](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-j/) **For more than a century, Oregonians have refused to be ignored. It 's time to do it again.**Together, we'll make sure the people, not the politicians, have the last word.Danielle Bethell
Marion County Commissioner
Republican Candidate for Governor of Oregon**P.S.** Oregon's referendum process exists for moments exactly like this one. Let's use it and send Salem a message they won't forget. [Visit My Website](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-t/) [Donate To My Campaign for Governor](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-i/) [](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-d/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-h/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-k/)[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-x/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-fb-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-m/) | [ Tweet ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-tw-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-c/) | [ Share ](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-li-qhifjk-hhlrhljhit-q/) | [ Forward ](https://daniellebethell.forwardtomyfriend.com/y-hhlrhljhit-E19159AE-qhifjk-l-a)
