_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Patriot, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**

**But it doesn 't happen without you.** _So, here 's my ask..._ Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. **For Charlie.** **God Bless,** **Tyler Bowyer**

clean_body: Charlie had the vision and the plan A tribute to Charlie & Turning Point Action—see how to help and double your impact today. | Patriot, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, " You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois." So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving. Above: The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... I knew. Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. Faith, family, freedom -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? He did it. He didn't just build a brand... He built a machine. First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it from the start. Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together. We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- and it delivered real results. 10 for 10. In every single state we operated in... Trump won. In Arizona alone, we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. In Wisconsin? 60,000+. In Nevada? 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. In Michigan? 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... We made history. Above: Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. Because Charlie never stopped. He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- and make it stronger than ever. Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- we must turn it into action. He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: " What are we building next?" Well, Patriot, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time. But it doesn 't happen without you. So, here 's my ask... Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work. For Charlie. God Bless, Tyler Bowyer Chief Operating Officer Turning Point Action P.S. I would give anything to have Charlie back. But he left us with something powerful -- a machine that works... a machine that's proven and battle-tested. Now it's time to run it -- and run it like never before. Bigger. Bolder. More battlegrounds. More victories. Because right now, thanks to a generous supporter of Turning Point Action, your gift will be matched dollar-for-dollar -- up to $500,000, through October 31. That means, with your gift today: ✅ 2X the activists trained ✅ 2X the voters registered ✅ 2X the pressure on weak-kneed politicians ✅ 2X the ballot-chasing operations ✅ 2X the grassroots strength the Left can't stop We don't need to reinvent anything. Charlie already drew the blueprint and turned the key. So, if you've been wondering how to help... If you've been asking " what now?" Then, Patriot, this is your moment to step in, fuel the fight, and take Charlie 's vision to the next level. Let's turn this energy -- this momentum -- into action. Recently, on the Senate floor, I laid out **ten ways Donald Trump is wrecking this country**. Every American should know that Trump is failing us by:
**10\. Undermining American innovation:** Trump is attacking our world-class research institutions and shutting out international talent, limiting our leadership in science, technology, and medicine.
**9\. Slashing food assistance:** He’s gutting the supplemental nutrition programs that keep millions of American families healthy and ensure our kids don’t go to bed hungry.
**8\. Abandoning our allies:** Trump is weakening our international partnerships, cozying up with dictators, and making America less safe.
**7\. Sabotaging renewable energy:** He’s killing clean energy projects, ceding global renewable energy leadership to China, raising utility bills, and making us more dependent on fossil fuels.
**6\. Damaging public health:** He’s slashing funding for the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and key research programs, meaning cures will be delayed, clinical trials will end, and life-saving care will be harder to access.
**5\. Crippling essential services with DOGE cuts:** From Social Security to wildfire response to public education, Trump is making major funding cuts without worrying about the impact on families, seniors, and kids across the country who will be hurt.
**4\. Tanking the economy with tariffs:** His trade wars are driving up the costs of everyday goods like clothes and groceries while alienating our allies.
**3\. Stripping away healthcare:** Under Trump’s new budget, millions of Americans will lose healthcare coverage. Many rural clinics and hospitals will be forced to close, and all of our healthcare costs will go up.
**2\. Undermining the rule of law:** Trump has been treating the Department of Justice (DOJ) as his own personal political weapon, using it to shield his allies and target his enemies.
**1\. Threatening the very idea of America:** He’s eroding the values that built this country: self-governance, equality, and the belief that no one is above the law — not even the president.
I know this is a lot. And overcoming it will be hard, especially in the near term when they control everything. But we will take back the government and put an end to this madness.
The GOP is trying to flood the zone so that we’re too overwhelmed to act. But I also know that we’re not powerless, and that we can come together, organize, mobilize, and take our country back from Trump.

Peter,
Today is World Mental Health Day. In Colorado and across the country, too many people still struggle in silence. Stigma, lack of resources, and barriers to care keep far too many of our friends, neighbors, and loved ones from getting the support they deserve. That has to change.
As Attorney General, I will fight to expand access to affordable mental health care, especially in rural and underserved areas, and make sure mental health care is treated as health care, not a luxury. I will work to invest in prevention programs that address the root causes of crime like trauma, addiction, and untreated mental illness. And I will support schools and families with resources that help children and young people build resilience and thrive.
We’ve all seen how stress, grief, and crisis can affect our communities — whether it’s veterans facing PTSD, young people struggling with depression and anxiety, or families impacted by substance use disorders.
We cannot afford to look away. Together, we can build a Colorado where no one has to suffer alone and where mental health support is accessible, affordable, and stigma-free.
Thank you for standing with me as we work for a healthier, safer, and more compassionate future. If you or anyone you know needs support, find some mental health resources in Colorado here. [https://coloradocrisisservices.org/about/]
With gratitude,
Jena Griswold

This morning, they missed their first paycheck. | | | Peter, Since Congress shut down on September 30, federal workers have either been off the job or working without pay. This morning, on October 10, they missed their first paycheck. Then text SHUTDOWN to 30403 (or call 833-636-3259) to use our call tool to urge your Senator to pass a funding bill that lowers health care costs. Here’s the bottom line: Trump and his MAGA cronies know that their ideas are despised by the majority of Americans. And they know that working families around the country blame them for this shutdown too. They also know that it’s too late to put the genie back in the bottle. Which is why they’re trying to punish federal employees and blame the rest of us for it. But federal employees are not bargaining chips. They are veterans, caregivers, and neighbors who serve their country and fellow Americans every day. They deserve stability and respect, not pink slips and political games. Then use our Senate call tool by texting SHUTDOWN to 30403 or dialing 833-636-3259 to make sure your elected officials know that they can’t cave to Trump’s demands. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? We've endorsed a strong slate of attorney general candidates this cycle, and will have even more in the coming months. Meet the extraordinary women ready to take on Trump:

**Attorney General Kris Mayes (AZ)** has emerged as a key leader in the fight against Trump. When the Trump administration attempted to slash funding for medical and public health research, she pushed back. She also went after corporations that were unfairly and illegally raising prices, and she is ready to continue her fight for Arizona families.

**Karen McDonald (MI)** is Michigan's Oakland County prosecutor and a former teacher and judge. She grew up in a working-class Michigan family and has spent her life fighting for her community. From the classroom to the courtroom, she has a proven record of fighting to protect Michigan children and families and making her state safer.

**Nicole Cannizzaro (NV)** is a lifelong Nevadan, mom, and the first woman to serve as majority leader of the Nevada state Senate. She has led the fight to permanently protect abortion rights and IVF in Nevada while shielding women and doctors from out-of-state legal attacks. As a prosecutor and legislator, she’s spent her career protecting families, expanding education, and making Nevada safer for everyone.

Republicans know that once I’m sworn in, it won’t just chip away at their razor-thin majority — I will become the decisive 218th signature to force a vote on releasing the Epstein files. Peter,
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton’s latest press release [https://www.texasattorneygeneral.gov/news/releases/attorney-general-ken-paxton-launches-undercover-operations-infiltrate-and-uproot-leftist-terror] is an authoritarian warning shot aimed at our communities and our rights. He’s openly green‐lighting undercover operations to “infiltrate and uproot” any community organizations he brands as “leftist terror cells,” smearing whole movements, including transgender Texans, to justify surveillance, intimidation, and repression. This is not normal. It’s not safety. It’s authoritarian political control.
Here at TOP PAC, we are built for moments like this. We mobilize Black and Latino Texans to protect our people, our votes, and our future — and we don’t flinch. But to meet this escalation head‐on, we need the full strength of supporters like YOU behind us.

We will remain vigilant and continue to stand with Palestinians, both in celebration and unequivocal freedom.

# Trump drops tariff BOMBSHELL on China!
President Donald Trump **[threatened a massive tariff hike](https://substack.com/redirect/d90c77d8-c6e0-41eb-9cde-04d3ddb98797?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Chinese imports and cancellation of a planned summit with Xi Jinping after Beijing signaled tighter controls on rare earth exports, sparking an immediate stock market plunge Thursday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d90c77d8-c6e0-41eb-9cde-04d3ddb98797?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Rare Earths Spark Escalation:** China's proposed restrictions on rare earth exports, vital for tech and defense, directly provoked Trump's aggressive response amid fragile trade talks.
* **Summit Hangs in Balance:** Officials were negotiating a Trump-Xi meeting in Beijing in the coming months, that is now jeopardized by the escalating dispute over mineral controls.
* **Markets Reel from Threat:** U.S. stocks tumbled following Trump's Truth Social post, underscoring investor fears of renewed trade war disruptions.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b1176be1-edfb-4d8d-96dd-6a8dc67f85b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump 's Statement:** _Some very strange things are happening in China! They are becoming very hostile, and sending letters to Countries throughout the World, that they want to impose Export Controls on each and every element of production having to do with Rare Earths, and virtually anything else they can think of, even if it 's not manufactured in China. Nobody has ever seen anything like this but, essentially, it would "clog" the Markets, and make life difficult for virtually every Country in the World, especially for China. We have been contacted by other Countries who are extremely angry at this great Trade hostility, which came out of nowhere. Our relationship with China over the past six months has been a very good one, thereby making this move on Trade an even more surprising one. I have always felt that they've been lying in wait, and now, as usual, I have been proven right! There is no way that China should be allowed to hold the World "captive," but that seems to have been their plan for quite some time, starting with the "Magnets" and, other Elements that they have quietly amassed into somewhat of a Monopoly position, a rather sinister and hostile move, to say the least. But the U.S. has Monopoly positions also, much stronger and more far reaching than China's. I have just not chosen to use them, there was never a reason for me to do so -- UNTIL NOW! The letter they sent is many pages long, and details, with great specificity, each and every Element that they want to withhold from other Nations. Things that were routine are no longer routine at all. I have not spoken to President Xi because there was no reason to do so. This was a real surprise, not only to me, but to all the Leaders of the Free World. I was to meet President Xi in two weeks, at APEC, in South Korea, but now there seems to be no reason to do so. The Chinese letters were especially inappropriate in that this was the Day that, after three thousand years of bedlam and fighting, there is PEACE IN THE MIDDLE EAST. Dependent on what China says about the hostile "order" that they have just put out, I will be forced, as President of the United States of America, to financially counter their move. Ultimately, though potentially painful, it will be a very good thing, in the end, for the U.S.A. One of the Policies that we are calculating at this moment is a massive increase of Tariffs on Chinese products coming into the United States of America. There are many other countermeasures that are, likewise, under serious consideration. Thank you for your attention to this matter! DONALD J. TRUMP, PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA_

# Billions of Dollars vanish in auto parts bankruptcy scandal due to "under the radar financing"
Billions of dollars in funds have **[mysteriously disappeared](https://substack.com/redirect/3f195053-b864-43b8-8db0-bc39d5eb7b69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from bankrupt Ohio auto parts supplier First Brands, as creditors uncover a chaotic web of "rehypothecated debt," **[shaking Wall Street's confidence](https://substack.com/redirect/a8714bcf-bdcf-479c-94ab-946c1edffcb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in a market distracted by AI hype.
* **Massive Debt Overload Uncovered** : First Brands' bankruptcy reveals $10-$50 billion in liabilities, far exceeding its $5.8 billion leveraged loan debt, due to hidden off-balance sheet financing.
* **Rehypothecation Sparks Chaos** : The company allegedly pledged receivables - "money a company expects to collect from its customers for goods or services already provided, but not yet paid for" \- as collateral **multiple times over** , creating a financial nightmare where no one knows who owns what because the same asset has been loaned or promised multiple times.
* **Onset Financial 's Huge Exposure**: Onset Financial is thought to be First Brands' largest creditor, claims $1.9 billion in exposure to losses going back to 2017

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/13689b70-1822-46b0-8466-7809cf92dd35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **UBS O 'Connor Faces Losses**: **[With 30% of its portfolio](https://substack.com/redirect/5a34fcff-08d0-4f7f-8964-35ed74fb6d9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** tied to First Brands, UBS O'Connor the hedge fund arm of the Swiss bank UBS braces for over $500 million in losses from loans that were issued against both invoices First Brands was due to pay (9.1%) but also loans that issued against invoices First Brand's _**[customers](https://substack.com/redirect/5a34fcff-08d0-4f7f-8964-35ed74fb6d9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_ were due to pay (21.4%)
* **Millennium Management Hit Hard** : The $80 billion hedge fund took a $100 million write down on short-term loans to First Brands, tied to loans that were made against current cashflow a process known as **[factoring.](https://substack.com/redirect/cea4b690-e192-4dc6-8522-b71bb07ee2f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* **CLOs Suffer Major Losses** : Collateralized loan obligations holding First Brands' debt, bought with private money but which has been "broadly syndicated" is now trading at 15 cents on the dollar, impacting asset management firms like PGIM, Blackstone **[and fund managers around the world.](https://substack.com/redirect/81c54ea0-1c9d-4714-8640-5302bdccc0f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* **Private Credit Funds Implicated** : First Brands' $2.3 billion in "factored" invoices and $682 million in "supply chain finance" also known as "reverse factoring" r**[eveal risky, opaque lending practices.](https://substack.com/redirect/a7456c0f-f562-4300-8e96-d6c1206f383e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** This is thought to have included paying First Brands' bills with the expectation to collect payment later,

* **Apollo and Diameter Profit** : Apollo and Diameter Capital Partners made gains by shorting (betting against) First Brands' debt, with Apollo known to have closed its position before the bankruptcy at a profit.
* **Jefferies ' Reputation Tarnished**: Jefferies, First Brands' long-time banker, faces severe scrutiny for its role in a failed $6 billion refinancing and its investment pargtner Point Bonita Capital.
* **Losses Keep Spiraling:** Morgan Stanley analysts originally put Point Bonita Capital's losses at $45m but this has since been upgraded to $113 million. exposure via Point Bonita Capital which had **[received investment by BlackRock.](https://substack.com/redirect/227c9601-67ad-40dc-afe9-f31a8d8f5ea3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **DOJ Launches Investigation:** The FT reports that the DOJ has begun an investigation in to the First Brand's collapse

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7d81f8c9-69a0-4cf8-8e98-a732a670513f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Systemic Risks?** : The full scale of First Brand's implosion is not yet known. Given the opaque and possibly fraudulent financing practices that First Brand's was engaged in, and has been uncovered so far. It is likely that in the coming days more losses will be announced.
* **Major players already making moves:** Bloomberg is reporting that BlackRock is seeking to withdraw funds they had invested in Jefferies Financial Group as the scale of the of the bankruptcy unfolds.

# Liberal Boston considers government run grocery stores latest socialist experiment
Boston officials are exploring the concept of **[government-owned grocery stores](https://substack.com/redirect/8a29b03d-cb2d-447d-b7fc-419afe498cb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to combat soaring food prices, with city councilors emphasizing intervention in failing markets amid a near-doubling of Massachusetts households facing food insecurity.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8a29b03d-cb2d-447d-b7fc-419afe498cb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **SNAP Cuts Heighten Urgency:** Federal reductions in SNAP benefits are exacerbating struggles for working families, prompting councilors to act swiftly on affordable food access.
* **Concept Draws From Precedents:** Officials cite successful government-subsidized grocers in Madison, Wisconsin, and Atlanta, Georgia, as models for Boston's potential initiative.
* **Industry Labels Job Killer:** Grocery experts warn that taxpayer-funded stores could devastate small businesses operating on thin margins, urging support for existing shops instead.
* **Economists Slam Government Inefficiency:** Critics argue city-run operations lack market discipline, potentially leading to higher costs, empty shelves, and no accountability for consumers.

# Morgan Stanley will begin offering Crypto products to clients
Wall Street titan Morgan Stanley is **[removing barriers to cryptocurrency](https://substack.com/redirect/cfadee66-3284-4836-9ebf-ff82f47b73f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** investments effective Oct. 15, allowing its army of financial advisors to pitch bitcoin funds to everyday wealth clients -- even in retirement accounts -- amid a post-election regulatory thaw under President Donald Trump.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cfadee66-3284-4836-9ebf-ff82f47b73f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Policy Barriers Crumble Swiftly:** Removes prior $1.5 million asset minimum and aggressive risk mandates, expanding access from elite-only to broad client base in any account type.
* **Risk Safeguards Fortified:** Morgan Stanley will deploy automated monitoring to cap crypto exposure, with a maximum exposure of 4% tailored to goals like "growth" or "preservation."
* **Funds Limited to Bitcoin Duo:** Advisors will be restricted to pitching only BlackRock and Fidelity bitcoin products for now, though clients may request other exchange-traded crypto options.
* **E-Trade Trading Looms Large:** This move builds on last month's plan to launch bitcoin, ether, and solana trading via Morgan Stanley's E-Trade platform as it eyes further crypto expansions.

They are becoming very hostile, and sending letters to Countries throughout the World, that they want to impose Export Controls on each and every element of production having to do with Rare Earths, and virtually anything else they can think of, even if it 's not manufactured in China. Nobody has ever seen anything like this but, essentially, it would "clog" the Markets, and make life difficult for virtually every Country in the World, especially for China. We have been contacted by other Countries who are extremely angry at this great Trade hostility, which came out of nowhere. Our relationship with China over the past six months has been a very good one, thereby making this move on Trade an even more surprising one. I have always felt that they've been lying in wait, and now, as usual, I have been proven right! There is no way that China should be allowed to hold the World "captive," but that seems to have been their plan for quite some time, starting with the "Magnets" and, other Elements that they have quietly amassed into somewhat of a Monopoly position, a rather sinister and hostile move, to say the least. The letter they sent is many pages long, and details, with great specificity, each and every Element that they want to withhold from other Nations. Things that were routine are no longer routine at all. I have not spoken to President Xi because there was no reason to do so. This was a real surprise, not only to me, but to all the Leaders of the Free World. I was to meet President Xi in two weeks, at APEC, in South Korea, but now there seems to be no reason to do so. I wonder if that timing was coincidental? For every Element that they have been able to monopolize, we have two. I never thought it would come to this but perhaps, as with all things, the time has come. Ultimately, though potentially painful, it will be a very good thing, in the end, for the U.S.A. One of the Policies that we are calculating at this moment is a massive increase of Tariffs on Chinese products coming into the United States of America. There are many other countermeasures that are, likewise, under serious consideration. Thank you for your attention to this matter! DONALD J. Onset Financial 's Huge Exposure: Onset Financial is thought to be First Brands' largest creditor, claims $1.9 billion in exposure to losses going back to 2017 | | ---|---|--- UBS O 'Connor Faces Losses: tied to First Brands, UBS O'Connor the hedge fund arm of the Swiss bank UBS braces for over $500 million in losses from loans that were issued against both invoices First Brands was due to pay (9.1%) but also loans that issued against invoices First Brand's were due to pay (21.4%) Millennium Management Hit Hard : The $80 billion hedge fund took a $100 million write down on short-term loans to First Brands, tied to loans that were made against current cashflow a process known as CLOs Suffer Major Losses : Collateralized loan obligations holding First Brands' debt, bought with private money but which has been "broadly syndicated" is now trading at 15 cents on the dollar, impacting asset management firms like PGIM, Blackstone Private Credit Funds Implicated : First Brands' $2.3 billion in "factored" invoices and $682 million in "supply chain finance" also known as "reverse factoring" r This is thought to have included paying First Brands' bills with the expectation to collect payment later, Apollo and Diameter Profit : Apollo and Diameter Capital Partners made gains by shorting (betting against) First Brands' debt, with Apollo known to have closed its position before the bankruptcy at a profit. ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
Across the country, Republicans know their policies are deeply unpopular, so they’re trying to hold onto power with partisan redistricting plans designed to silence voters and protect their majority in the U.S. House.
In Texas, Republicans surrendered to Donald Trump and passed a racially gerrymandered map that dilutes the voices of minority voters and in doing so wipes out five Democratic seats. And across the country, Republicans are pushing partisan maps to lock in their power—from Ohio to Missouri to Indiana.
Now, California is fighting back . The legislature passed a map that could help Democrats gain five seats in 2026 to even out the impact of this power imbalance thanks to Texas’ redistricting efforts—but it only takes effect if voters approve Proposition 50, the Election Rigging Response Act , allowing mid-decade redistricting to undo GOP power grabs .
Election Day is just 25 days away—and with Californians already voting, we need your help right now.
Phonebank with Team Lizzie to Support Prop 50 and Fight for Fair Maps!
Join Team Lizzie and our special guest, Congresswoman Sara Jacobs, at our virtual phonebank to call voters and let them know what's happening!

Sign up to phonebank here: https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/858314/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/858314/]

subject: 10 ways Donald Trump is wrecking this country

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=9063%2E5257348%2EpRDeG- ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek —

I’m not going to sugarcoat it. We’re up against a movement that’s
determined to tear down our democracy and a man in the White House who’ll
do anything to expand his power, including the misuse of our military to
achieve his own ends.

We’ve got to keep calling out the danger, no matter what. That’s why I’m
reaching out today to ask you to [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q42025_abs_em.dd-KUe&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20251010_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=9063%2E5257348%2EpRDeG- ]donate to support my reelection
campaign and help me keep fighting back against Trump’s attacks on the
rule of law.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=q42025_abs_em.SCwor2&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20251010_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=9063%2E5257348%2EpRDeG- ]DONATE

Recently, on the Senate floor, I laid out ten ways Donald Trump is
wrecking this country. Every American should know that Trump is failing us
by:

10. Undermining American innovation: Trump is attacking our world-class
research institutions and shutting out international talent, limiting
our leadership in science, technology, and medicine.

9. Slashing food assistance: He’s gutting the supplemental nutrition
programs that keep millions of American families healthy and ensure
our kids don’t go to bed hungry.

8. Abandoning our allies: Trump is weakening our international
partnerships, cozying up with dictators, and making America less safe.

7. Sabotaging renewable energy: He’s killing clean energy projects,
ceding global renewable energy leadership to China, raising utility
bills, and making us more dependent on fossil fuels.

6. Damaging public health: He’s slashing funding for the National
Institutes of Health (NIH) and key research programs, meaning cures
will be delayed, clinical trials will end, and life-saving care will
be harder to access.

5. Crippling essential services with DOGE cuts: From Social Security to
wildfire response to public education, Trump is making major funding
cuts without worrying about the impact on families, seniors, and kids
across the country who will be hurt.

4. Tanking the economy with tariffs: His trade wars are driving up the
costs of everyday goods like clothes and groceries while alienating
our allies.

3. Stripping away healthcare: Under Trump’s new budget, millions of
Americans will lose healthcare coverage. Many rural clinics and
hospitals will be forced to close, and all of our healthcare costs
will go up.

2. Undermining the rule of law: Trump has been treating the Department of
Justice (DOJ) as his own personal political weapon, using it to shield
his allies and target his enemies.

1. Threatening the very idea of America: He’s eroding the values that
built this country: self-governance, equality, and the belief that no
one is above the law — not even the president.

I know this is a lot. And overcoming it will be hard, especially in the
near term when they control everything. But we will take back the
government and put an end to this madness.

The GOP is trying to flood the zone so that we’re too overwhelmed to act.
But I also know that we’re not powerless, and that we can come together,
organize, mobilize, and take our country back from Trump.

Derek, I hope you’ll make a
contribution to support my work standing up to Trump in the Senate.

Tuesday, I talked about the end of the "both sides" argument.
Well if this week has shown us anything, it's that even though both sidesism is dead, double standards are alive and well.
Just think about the headlines of the week.
Jones's disgusting texts and bad behavior.
A Democrat-led government shutdown.
Katie Porter's treatment of media and staff.
The common thread in all of these stories?
A big yawn from the media.
Mainstream outlets jump all over the right for anything they can find.
A Republican jaywalks? Huge deal.
But a Democrat fantasizes about killing Republicans and their families? Zero coverage.
Let's break down the hypocrisy...

Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.

https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3xfaa&__onlt=t

Friend,

Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie.

His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us.

And his vision — to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history — is why Turning Point USA exists today.

Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you...

In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:

https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3xfaa&__onlt=t

God is so good. ✝️🙏🕊️

To give you perspective, Friend...

Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters.

It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... But now?

These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited...

They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.

Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.

https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3xfaa&__onlt=t

He always believed this day would come.

He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America.

And now...

It's happening.

Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible.

And more beautiful than we can even describe.

Again, Friend, God is so good.

Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages.

Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives.

And so many supporters have asked, "What can I do?"

As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request.

And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits.

Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:

✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear

Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... this won't be a small task.

But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. For Charlie.

And here's how YOU can help with this...

Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...

How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?

| Letter from the Chair
---
As I plan and strategize for the Nebraska Republican Party's goals in the 2026 elections and beyond, I find myself reflecting on the NEGOP's rich history and enduring legacy.
As we know, the Republican Party was born in the wake of the Kansas-Nebraska Act of 1854, forged from a coalition of former Whigs, Free Soilers, and anti-slavery Democrats united under the powerful slogan, "Free Labor, Free Land, Free Men." In 1854, Abraham Lincoln emerged from retirement to embrace this new party, which formalized its platform in 1856, setting the stage for a transformative era in American politics.
Recently, while sifting through memorabilia in the NEGOP office, I uncovered more treasures from our party's storied past. I found that starting in 1935, the NEGOP had hosted a Founders Day Celebration to honor individuals who have made significant contributions to both the party and the state of Nebraska. Serving on the Founders Day Committee was considered a great honor, nearly as prestigious as receiving recognition at the event itself.
This year, we proudly mark the 90th anniversary of the NEGOP Founders Day. To commemorate this milestone, we are reviving the tradition with a special Founders Day Dinner on December 11th in Omaha. This event will celebrate our honorees and provide an opportunity for us to come together, reflect on our remarkable history, and look forward to a promising future. More details will follow, but for now, save the date! Join us as we honor those who have contributed to the NEGOP's enduring legacy and who continue to inspire us as we plan our future.

Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

Serving on the Founders Day Committee was considered a great honor, nearly as prestigious as receiving recognition at the event itself. This year, we proudly mark the 90th anniversary of the NEGOP Founders Day. To commemorate this milestone, we are reviving the tradition with a special Founders Day Dinner on December 11th in Omaha. This event will celebrate our honorees and provide an opportunity for us to come together, reflect on our remarkable history, and look forward to a promising future. More details will follow, but for now, save the date! Join us as we honor those who have contributed to the NEGOP's enduring legacy and who continue to inspire us as we plan our future. name: Stasha Rhodes, United for Democracy
subject: “A grim Supreme Court term”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by United for Democracy
body:
Donald Trump is the main character at the Supreme Court this term. | |
---
Peter, **We might as well give Donald Trump some robes and a gavel at the Supreme Court.** After all, he’s the main character in the new term, which just kicked off on Monday. Friends,

One month ago, our nation and faith communities were shaken by the senseless killing of Charlie Kirk, a man whose passion for
truth, courage, and conviction inspired millions to stand boldly for faith and freedom. His absence has left a deep mark, not just
in the public square, but in the hearts of those who shared his vision: that believers should bring light into every corner of
culture - including government.

We chose, in those first days, inward reflection and prayer for the Kirk family, instead of adding to the noise. But now, as the
weeks have passed, a question weighs heavy on our hearts:

Have we already moved on?

The fire that was sparked in the days following Charlie Kirk's murder - the resolve, the unity, the call to action - it must not
fade! Revival doesn’t end when the headlines do. It begins within our hearts and stays ablaze long after the moment has passed.

If we truly want to see change in our churches, our communities, and our nation, it begins with us. It begins with renewed prayer,
bold faith, and unwavering action. God often uses seasons of loss to awaken His people, to remind us that we are called for more
than comfort...we are called for impact!

Let’s honor Charlie’s legacy not with words, but with movement. Let’s keep the fire burning. Let’s stay focused. Let’s see revival
spark a great awakening in our nation. Project 29:2 is committed.

Are you?

Carol is a mom, an immigrant, an engineer, an educator, and a lifelong community leader. She's spent her career delivering results for families in Pennsylvania — making housing, groceries, and utilities more affordable, expanding opportunity for children, and serving her neighbors with compassion and grit.

**This is exactly the kind of leadership Pennsylvania's 7th Congressional District needs.**

Peter, Republicans are calling their continuing resolution a “clean CR.” Let’s call it what it really is: _a dirty bomb intended to dismantle health care as we know it._ For NY-10, Republicans’ definition of “clean” means that 8,000 people will face massive premium hikes and over 40,000 will lose their health care coverage _entirely_. Nationwide, 15 million people will lose their coverage and seniors will see $500 billion stolen from Medicare. **There’s _nothing_ “clean” about cruelly jeopardizing the health, security, and dignity of our communities.** My colleagues across the aisle can point fingers all they want, but the truth is that Republicans control all three branches of government. All we’re asking to do is fix some of the health care cost crisis they created. Instead, they shut down the government and refuse to negotiate with Democrats, even though they need Democratic votes to pass a bill. Democrats are on the ground, fighting for health care for all Americans and to keep the government open and working. Meanwhile, Speaker Johnson sent House Republicans back on vacation while Republican Senators are schmoozing wealthy billionaires at a luxury resort in Georgia. name: Team Bennet
subject: re: RFK Jr. & abortion rights
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bennet for Governor
body:
Since Michael's running a people-powered campaign, he wants to make sure he's in line with his grassroots base on this hot-button issue.
| | |
---
**Folks, we have good news and bad news. We'll start with the bad news:**
Just a couple of weeks ago, Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. promised Republican state attorneys general that the Food and Drug Administration would "review" the safety of the medication abortion mifepristone.
(AKA, he vowed to find any excuse for them to limit women's access to the proven-safe and effective pill...that has been used for the past 25 years.)

clean_body: I often get asked, "Were you really willing to put your life on the line for a country you weren't even born in?" And to that, I say absolutely. Semper Fi. Always faithful. I often get asked, "Were you really willing to put your life on the line for a country you weren't even born in? And to that, I say absolutely. Friend, my name is Winsome Earle-Sears. I don't often make promises, but I can promise you this: I'm not your typical politician, and I'm not like the others who normally send you these messages: -I immigrated to the US from Jamaica with my family when I was six years old. -I served in the Marine Corps as an electrician. -I ran a women's homeless shelter and a men's prison ministry. I've lived a full, rewarding life - and I owe it all to this country. In a world of so much uncertainty, I know one thing to be 100% true: my story is only possible in America. And now, I'm running for Governor of Virginia - to make certain that the same country that let a poor, black woman ascend to the highest levels of politics remains that way - a beacon of hope. But the reality we have to confront is that those on the Left are actively trying to tear this down. They aim to destroy the middle class, strip away our 2nd Amendment rights, and brainwash our children. Not on my watch. We have a long journey ahead of us, but we will be better off with you on our side. So Who's Staffing Their New Air Force Base in Idaho?](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2114823&post_id=175828956&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTc1ODI4OTU2LCJpYXQiOjE3NjAxMjM2MDEsImV4cCI6MTc2MjcxNTYwMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTIxMTQ4MjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.IXvRoIOCuw3iND98FTCcDp82C25LmA1D7Q3mxn6r_kA)

Let me get this straight...
Qatar, a country with maybe 300,000 actual citizens, [is putting a military base on American soil. In Idah](https://substack.com/redirect/98a8e627-29cc-4a75-a05e-4e56577009a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)o.
Who exactly is going to staff this base?
Qatar doesn't have people (90% of Qatar is temporary foreign workers from South Asia brought in on work visas) So what's the plan here?
Are we going to have THOUSANDS more visa workers shipped to Mountain Home, Idaho to operate a Qatari Air Force base?
Because Qatar sure as hell doesn't have the citizens to do it themselves!
Their entire society runs on imported slave labor (e.g. thousands died building their World Cup stadiums).
And now we're going to recreate that model in Idaho?
As if we don't have enough foreign nationals here already?
More foreign visa workers, more exploitation, more displacement of American workers and American interests.
_**This isn 't America first. **_
_**This is America last.**_
Why are we allowing a micro-state with fewer citizens than Wichita, Kansas to set up a military installation in our heartland, staffed by who knows who from who knows where?
We already have Mountain Home Air Force Base.
We don't need Qatar's imported workforce operating military facilities on American soil.
This is insulting.
This is absurd.
This undermines everything we stand for.

name: Tyler Bowyer, Turning Point Action
subject: We started with nothing but a dream to save America.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TURNING POINT ACTION (TPACTION
body:
#
[https://secure.anedot.com/tpaction/734b2647-83e5-477e-9fe1-d182e4fb42e2?source_code=MAWCO72488&utm_medum=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ck_legacy_match&utm_term=MAWCO72488]

Friend,

When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn’t famous.

He wasn’t filling arenas. He wasn’t a household name.

A few people told me, _“You’ve gotta meet this guy — he’s
doing something big out in Illinois.”_

So I went.

Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago
suburbs — surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still
worth saving.

#
[https://secure.anedot.com/tpaction/734b2647-83e5-477e-9fe1-d182e4fb42e2?source_code=MAWCO72488&utm_medum=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ck_legacy_match&utm_term=MAWCO72488]

_ABOVE: The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is
where it all began — just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that
changed everything. _

Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming
about how to win back the culture.

But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._

Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of
it.

I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there
for all of it.

The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The
fights.

In those days, our team didn’t have much. But what we had was
conviction — and that was more than enough.

Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something
urgent.

FAITH, FAMILY, FREEDOM — and the absolute grit to go build something
that could save this country.

And Charlie? _He did it._

He didn’t just build a brand... _He built a machine._

First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of
an entire generation — a seismic shift that flipped the narrative
that young people belonged to the Left.

Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the
Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game.

And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._

Charlie and I weren’t just friends...

We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.

#
[https://secure.anedot.com/tpaction/734b2647-83e5-477e-9fe1-d182e4fb42e2?source_code=MAWCO72488&utm_medum=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ck_legacy_match&utm_term=MAWCO72488]

We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID,
the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us...

We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action
to go on offense — in the very states the GOP had given up on.

AND WE RALLIED A GRASSROOTS ARMY THAT PUT PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP
BACK IN THE WHITE HOUSE IN 2024.

We didn’t just talk about chasing ballots...

Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional
ballot-chasing operation on the Right — _and it delivered real
results._

10 for 10.

IN EVERY SINGLE STATE WE OPERATED IN... TRUMP WON.

In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative
votes — well beyond the margin of victory.

_In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+.

_In Nevada?_ 6,000+ — and we won back a district we hadn’t carried
in 20 years.

_In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take
the state house majority.

We didn’t just make noise... _We made history. _

#
[https://secure.anedot.com/tpaction/734b2647-83e5-477e-9fe1-d182e4fb42e2?source_code=MAWCO72488&utm_medum=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ck_legacy_match&utm_term=MAWCO72488]

_ABOVE: Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That’s me on the
left — still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _

Patriot, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission.

He lived on the road 300+ days a year.

We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _

He didn’t build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did
it for this country. For all of us.

For every parent who feels like they’re losing their kid to the
Left...

For every student who’s afraid to speak up...

For every American who still believes in this country...

Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you.

And now? After he gave everything for that mission?

WE HAVE TO CARRY THE TORCH. WE HAVE TO KEEP THE MACHINE RUNNING —
_AND MAKE IT STRONGER THAN EVER._

Everything we’ve felt since the day we lost Charlie — _we must
turn it into action._

He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time:
_“What are we building next?”_

WELL, FRIEND, HERE’S THE ANSWER: WE’RE BUILDING THE NEXT
GENERATION OF GRASSROOTS POWER — ONE VOTER, ONE PRECINCT, ONE ACT OF
COURAGE AT A TIME.

#
[https://secure.anedot.com/tpaction/734b2647-83e5-477e-9fe1-d182e4fb42e2?source_code=MAWCO72488&utm_medum=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ck_legacy_match&utm_term=MAWCO72488]

BUT IT DOESN’T HAPPEN WITHOUT YOU.

_So, here’s my ask..._

Go to church for Charlie.

Start a family for Charlie.

Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie.

Register to vote for Charlie.

Chase votes for Charlie.

Run for office for Charlie.

Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started.

That’s what Charlie would’ve wanted.

I’m not stopping until we save our country. I’m all in — and if
you’re reading this, I’m betting that you are, too.

If so, I’m honored to fight alongside you. And if you’ve already
been with us for a while — thank you.

Now, let’s get to work.

FOR CHARLIE.

GOD BLESS,

TYLER BOWYER
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point Action

#
[https://secure.anedot.com/tpaction/734b2647-83e5-477e-9fe1-d182e4fb42e2?source_code=MAWCO72488&utm_medum=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ck_legacy_match&utm_term=MAWCO72488]

SUPPORT TURNING POINT ACTION
[https://secure.anedot.com/tpaction/734b2647-83e5-477e-9fe1-d182e4fb42e2?source_code=MAWCO72488&utm_medum=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ck_legacy_match&utm_term=MAWCO72488]

P.S. I would give anything to have Charlie back.

But he left us with something powerful — a machine that works... a
machine that’s proven and battle-tested.

Now it’s time to run it — _and run it like never before._

Bigger. Bolder. More battlegrounds. More victories.

BECAUSE RIGHT NOW, THANKS TO A GENEROUS SUPPORTER OF TURNING POINT
ACTION, YOUR GIFT WILL BE MATCHED DOLLAR-FOR-DOLLAR — UP TO
$500,000, THROUGH OCTOBER 31.

That means, with your gift today:

✅ 2X the activists trained
✅ 2X the voters registered
✅ 2X the pressure on weak-kneed politicians
✅ 2X the ballot-chasing operations
✅ 2X the grassroots strength the Left can’t stop

We don’t need to reinvent anything. Charlie already drew the
blueprint and turned the key.

So, if you’ve been wondering how to help... If you’ve been asking
_“what now?”_

THEN, PATRIOT, THIS IS YOUR MOMENT TO STEP IN, FUEL THE FIGHT, AND
TAKE CHARLIE’S VISION TO THE NEXT LEVEL.

Let’s turn this energy — this momentum — into action.

LET’S DELIVER AMERICA FIRST VICTORIES IN EVERY CORNER OF THIS
COUNTRY. AND MANY MORE FOR YEARS TO COME. MAKE YOUR GIFT TO TURNING
POINT ACTION TODAY AND IMMEDIATELY DOUBLE YOUR IMPACT.
[https://secure.anedot.com/tpaction/734b2647-83e5-477e-9fe1-d182e4fb42e2?source_code=MAWCO72488&utm_medum=email&utm_source=hardask_acq&utm_campaign=ck_legacy_match&utm_term=MAWCO72488]

SUPPORT TURNING POINT ACTION
& DOUBLE YOUR IMPACT

PAID FOR BY TURNING POINT ACTION (TPACTION.COM) AND NOT AUTHORIZED BY

4930 East Beverly Road

Phoenix, Arizona 85044

I’m not a standard politician.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117047403/575176660/477745408?amount=15&refcode=email_101025_pour&refcode2=sl2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDJlZGNkOC0wZmE2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pc7-HlHTdVzg4GPKe1hQeXnbSro7A5etDe4usqusxKM=) John Hickenlooper here. Have a sec? 🍻 I’m not your standard politician. For years, I was a geologist. Then, our company got bought, and we all got laid off. I took every scrap of savings in my bank account, even put my house up as collateral, to open a restaurant (with a brewery) in downtown Denver. We were known for our flagship brews, like Timberline Pale Ale and Sagebrush Stout. We charged just $2.25 a pint. I loved the brewpub. I loved bringing people together from all over with different opinions and creating a team to deliver them something special, something they would tell their friends about. And let me tell you, there was nothing we couldn’t solve over a nice, cold beer. I didn’t run for office for fame, or money, or power. I ran for Senate because I wanted to bring people together and _actually_ get stuff done. And turns out, a heck of a lot of Coloradans were tired of Washington politicians standing up for their ultra-wealthy donors instead of delivering progress for regular families like yours and mine. **But look, we already know that National Republicans and corporate PACs are going to _pour_ millions of dollars into Colorado to try and take back this seat. ** We’ll need a serious people-powered movement to keep pushing back against their attacks and prevent another MAGA extremist from winning this seat and trampling all over everything we care about. Peter,

For decades, those in power promised that if we just let the rich get
richer, something would “trickle down” to the rest of us.

Well, I don’t know about you, but I’m not seeing it. It’s the polar
opposite:

[ More ]More Perfect Union @MorePerfectUS: U.S. billionaires reached a record
breaking $7.6 trillion in wealth as of September 2025, an increase of $4.7
trillion in the less than eight years. Most of that wealth hasn’t been
taxed and won’t be taxed under our current system — per @4TaxFairness.

Working people are still paying outrageous prices for eggs, for
prescriptions, for the basics we need to get by. Meanwhile, corporations
keep reporting record profits and CEOs keep giving themselves bonuses.

This is the status quo in Washington — and it’s broken. It serves the
people at the very top while the rest of us fall further behind.

I’m running for Senate because I believe we can build something better.

We can take on corporate greed, fight for Medicare for All, and make sure
government finally works for working people, not just the wealthy few.

But first, I need to make it through this competitive primary. The
establishment’s preferred candidate in our race has corporate PACs
bankrolling their campaign. I have you.

And honestly? I like our odds better.

Can I count on your support today?

name: Reid Rasner, CEO
subject: Shutdown in the Headlines. Here's What to Keep in Mind.
body:
| Hi Peter, You've probably seen the headlines: the U.S. government has shut down again. It is the kind of story that dominates the news cycle, stirs up anxiety, and makes investors wonder, "Should I be doing something?" But here is the thing: headlines are not the whole story. And a disciplined strategy does not panic over politics. Let's walk through what is happening, what it could mean for you, and why it is not a reason to hit the panic button. A government shutdown happens when Congress cannot agree on a budget. Without a funding deal, certain government operations pause until lawmakers reach a compromise. It is a bit like a flight hitting turbulence. The plane is still flying, but the seatbelt sign is on. The pilot has asked everyone to stay seated, and the flight attendants have temporarily stopped service. Things feel uncertain, but the essential systems are still running, and the crew is working to smooth things out. **So what does this mean in practical terms?**
* Many federal workers are furloughed without pay.
* Social Security checks still go out, but new applications or benefit changes could be delayed.
* Passport offices and IRS services may slow down or close.
* FAFSA processing and Medicare updates might take longer than usual.

And the markets? They tend to dislike uncertainty, but they have also shown a history of resilience. Over the 22 shutdowns since 1976, the S&P; 500's performance has varied—rising during some closures and falling during others. Across all these episodes, the average return was about 0.3%, suggesting these disruptions tend to have minimal lasting impact.1 Of course, past performance does not guarantee future results. Every shutdown is different. But historically, markets have often taken these disruptions in stride. Which brings us to what really matters: your plan. This is not the first shutdown, and it will not be the last. Markets rise. Politics clash. Headlines flare up. But a plan should be designed for moments like this.
* Diversified? You are spreading risk, not stacking it.
* Focused on the long term? You are built to ride out short-term noise.
* Working with a financial professional? You are not reacting. You are staying ready.

The goal was never to avoid uncertainty. It was to be prepared for it.

Sincerely,

## Pearl Harbor Widow Donates Husband's Bullet
Eighty-four years after the Pearl Harbor attack, 106-year-old Alice Beck Darrow has [donated the bullet](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu2zAMRb9G3hRQjC0ng4Yu3l7XjobyRMdMZSugmBj--8Ip-gVdCAL3gjg8v77Gr8iZ1_vPuFCY7tOoUxlX2momVZLx9sqZdJKy6EwzRVGV-KbMIwJ21oF1MKbIeR-7JoWJCOncUHC9B4f-cvXNHNyZUuzdrSX0CB35C7RtCx77C5y7_tZwOK45cIAAF9edfGwxTRSvHXSARKYFSqxFTo_Cq8405b28SU7fZWlymFWf1Zx_GBwMDtu2nRbOrFF25YXq0TI4vElJ4loNDv9iO3PVIrvB4SAwOMD12I8R7d_nbVV5ff8-qvZjwEa1T4qS7RzlVuSTbJzKZh-vqlZIX7JSsqwGh0ZCem6cM1ffmxbuS-T84db_Fv4O-CcAAP__QYyXwg) that pierced her late husband's heart to the Pearl Harbor National Memorial Museum. U.S. sailor Dean Darrow survived the 1941 attack aboard the _USS West Virginia_ and [met Alice](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGSqzAQRE8jMlGjAQkcKPgJmX-6ITVYI6NdgVxCtsq338JX2Lzrdb_-us5XCjHs9_-0sfV3Pxef5p3rEbkUzvPyjJGLz2krK69MuZRML45hRkAtFUgFs6MQ37NunPXMyF3DVg0GFJrxYprV6lHjsoBRoLWGgfjW-2U0hrp-WIaha4I9aQoUIMCodGuoR-eZLho0ILPogV0oKbffKexlZR_f6cW5vaWtiXYt5XGI7p_ASeBUa21XqhTCKbKneqYETmeHwAkuAqcOBE4KjHwzZZmikzW4VOVGP3zIj6j0HIt0aacS0i4fTDnKlfKSstyeBz9PZpOte9QQYzjMIHq4bxTiZ1X5850vi78BAAD__1kQisE), then a Navy nurse, while recovering at Mare Island Naval Hospital. Surgeons later removed the bullet, which the couple kept as a symbol of survival throughout their 49-year marriage. It's the first time the relic has left Alice's possession since World War II--now part of America's shared history. **📸 For additional material,[hop over to _The Feel Good Flyover Podcast_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAUheGnwVusCxhiDwyVoqhL2rHdEDaXQIVNhK9t5e2r9BW6niN9w_91szeXclruH25GE-7BUih2wWPNSITVjlvOSKGWmSJGdJWouh1zsgKEOnE4cbDepfy0qvEmIAqUDRp-1sCF7gfdRKNkgBHcMIEDhdOgXfCoR-mVFOjV2CTz0jhwEAA9V612nfAB3aBAgUBkHaBPVGr7U9JCEUN-lh1rO5W5ySYSPVYm35i4MnE9jqN9lo22EV__a3E0RSavO5OX3i7n7_L-uameCU1MXlS3NtX4x5FyTqs-sw7us0v5D6d_V9mN-A0AAP__AXB3cw) and watch host Amy Hess bring this story to life.**
## A Kindness Not Forgotten
Jennifer McLaughlin was just 9 years old when her sister was killed in a car crash in Fullerton, California. In the chaotic aftermath of the accident, [one stranger stayed by her side](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u4yAQxfGnwR3RMDb-KCi2cZdtt7SIGQwrbCyYJPLbXyWvcOufdHT0_3df7jameGx_7U7Gb35hn5eD3jURM5Xl8UyJ2Je8c6BAtjAX-6IUFwTUUoFUsDgb07XoxhlPhNQ2ZNTQg8J-nPommE7DMHrlxweRQ9WuuhtWmDz1CtpJjU00nzUFChBgVPrW2w6dJztp0IBEogNykXO5_c_x4EA-XflF5bbmvUkmMJ9VtH8EzgJn-1iHDwicz1xZ4JyLPTaSa34efMl33u0hCz2PyFRl5a8WGSid5OQaYnJyLbYG2Wp5kS1VJstUBM5qmNoWehQ4N8W48x1TirUfRAfbbmP6HuJfl3wZ_AkAAP__usmJqA): Rhonda Ray, a young mom who comforted Jennifer, rode with her to the hospital, and waited until her parents arrived. Decades later, Jennifer posted in a local Facebook group, hoping to find Rhonda. The message reached Rhonda's daughter, leading to an emotional reunion marked by tears and a long-overdue expression of gratitude. Back in touch, the two are bonded for life by a single act of kindness neither ever forgot. ## Canine Comfort for Wounded Soldiers
At a military hospital in Bogotá, Colombia, [emotional support dogs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAQhJ8GMo_aPxhv4OCSyfbSC1GD2-BTg5HpndW8_Yl7hQ1LJZXq-_58Tp9YuBzrb9wp5jVPkut00PfFJEJtmr-YSXKru2y0ETaRhi_iMhkwg9KgNEwJC7-noU8xExmyPUU9etDGhw_fb9Gjw-Ad6DGHbIMN6BNkDz4Fa5Od-xLvNQ0aDEDQw8OjMykTfgwwgCHqHFAqUtvjby2HbJT5XV_UHkvde46byHl19ldnnp154nkD3NUdmpSFqTPPpXLd54KK9iqlHsjq-jrP2kSlul5qI7xNqKtyKtQutdQjc1lEZWyLSiHM4JINyXtLyTqXjEccwmC1Nzj2LabzuzCXy4-dg3XHwv__yY_FvqL5FwAA__8oio7q) are helping soldiers recover from war wounds and trauma. The “furry force” visits troops injured by landmines and drone attacks, offering comfort and companionship. Watch a [video of dogs in action](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFqwzAQxvGnkbeY09mW7UFDoXhLoVDoKGT7LlKRo6BcbPL2JX2Frt8Hv-H_fXZnH1O8Xj78RpYv7ISzu9JxTyRCxc2PlEi45E0CBfJFpPidUnQI2J00nDS41cf0dF21WiZCaiqyujeg0QyjqYJl03OP89wsBpD7cVmhJR7nnplp0bqK9qVp0IAAg-5q41tcmfzYQQdIpFqgNUou9U-OVwnE6Zl3KvWStyrZIHK7q-ZN4aRwOo6jfuaHPGZ6_a_FyxJUM-2qeZ-mr9lL_ByGc1XsejtiSvFuetXCZfMx_ZHy7xa7xd8AAAD__-35dSc). Launched in 2024, the program now allows patients to bring their own pets and provides wellness sessions for hospital staff. For soldiers like Luis Miguel López, who lost a leg to a mine, the dogs have helped lift depression and revive memories of loyal canine comrades in combat.

It’s Vance’s second visit in just over two months. Unlike in Missouri and Texas, the administration has found issues convincing the Republican lawmakers here to bow to the President on this issue. It’s clear that Hoosiers oppose this blatant power grab. Another poll came out this week showing an overwhelming majority of Indiana voters oppose any attempts to redraw the lines mid-decade. ****_Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117050012/575185895/289507754?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTNhYzU4NC0xOWE2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3qv7NtP8ngXDQqZOHdciU8GCPciD9-Q_VRdIkE0gBLg=&emci=b24da4ca-15a6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=a53ac584-19a6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=4925535) Even as the government shutdown rages on past its second week, Democrats are fighting back to protect the healthcare access of millions of Americans, and to reopen the government. **TrumpRX Is a Prescription for Lower Drug Prices** By Bobby Jindal and Hannah Anderson
---
President Donald Trump’s negotiations with pharmaceutical companies demonstrate how his _Art of the Deal_ approach to governance produces results for working-class Americans. President Trump is the first national leader willing to drain the swamp, taking on powerful lobbyists and special interests to deliver lower prices for patients. Democrats have simply shifted costs from patients to taxpayers, while Republicans have too often been reluctant to take on generous corporate donors. The result has been that Americans spend more on health care than other developed countries, but have shorter average life expectancies. President Trump, on September 30, made news by announcing a deal with Pfizer—the first of many—to secure most favored nation pricing for Medicaid patients on the company's existing drugs and for all Americans on its new drugs. This means American patients will no longer pay three to four times more than patients in other developed countries for the same drugs. The creation of TrumpRx, a website where American patients with a prescription can go to purchase drugs directly from drug manufacturers, received far less attention Yet, direct-to-consumer (DTC) pricing models like TrumpRx could have a huge impact. For instance, Eucrisa, a drug prescribed to approximately a million American patients with eczema at almost $1,000 a tube, will be offered to Americans at an 80 percent discount—bringing the price under $200. **[Finish reading at Newsweek.com](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=c50a5c1041a34757b1cce209ecc71b02&_e=kJ-UN8Np6JbEJb0gsPDiFzO4_NhaJpvu1dqlK1z6L97qg5oEHIGuGlu-DqAzsAIMOlF2TGxS3Rhr48C6-Lya2ma2tlq-Iy6-P5wHBfevc_vJxdgulxV50Qqx4KBaWK7FrlNPfvGML7sTQ4g0tw22a9i8NPBUkeH6WmF4MfURUjqVZA-0zp8aFnNvNUPqsBvsSlrH4wce2dooWr0v8-tg-IijaPxX1OOdyxBJqCcBgnDNbCdChJhLSFjAB3noP4uvVWobCg7godxIV_9ihVnXEcq6Pj8UAjBVaRaly6bomhI4zrnZFC2nDDIEavSILwbtWG9BFbJgPBlTbqGzlWrGeDoZlKmnclI4nmxxv2A9XsePA24SEJwDLlHgGn1tByapja0SlEUyBL9KW_jG8-6d2VBJni4y-E3moNyfT71yFPQL8ernpe1fYPFk6ZVby2bG5-E9hKmcmPCOLL8jo1jFBg%3D%3D)**

That’s why electing Jocelyn Benson is critical. That’s what’s at stake.

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Axios: Dominion Voting sold to company run by ex-GOP election official [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/Axios_DominionVotingSale.png]
Axios recently broke news that Dominion Voting Systems — makers of voting machines used in 27 states for elections across the country — has been sold to a Missouri-based company run by a former Republican election official.
Scott Leiendecker is the owner of KNOWiNK, which is changing its corporate name to "Liberty Vote", and has previously been appointed by Missouri officials to investigate the 2000 election and be " St. Louis' Republican election director ."
Leiendecker told Axios in a statement that his company is " committed to delivering election technology that prioritizes paper-based transparency, security and simplicity so that voters can be assured that every ballot is filled-in accurately and fairly counted ."
We want to hear from supporters in your area about this tactic. Will you take our one-click poll right away?

At a time when families are already struggling with high prices and a weak job market, Republicans in Congress are doubling down on a health care crisis of their own making.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117051406/575189785/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDg4N2VhNS0xY2E2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TmE4C3yxMSREBVV014AXQjB0OpJpY04bFObrfCh2dyA=&emci=621c1daf-4ba5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=4d887ea5-1ca6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=9494239)
---

| | At a time when families are already struggling with high prices and a weak job market, Republicans in Congress are doubling down on a health care crisis of their own making. **Deep Medicaid cuts, major changes to Medicare coverage, and the pending expiration of essential health care tax credits are creating immense uncertainty in the health care market**. Employers are bracing for the largest annual increase in health care costs in 15 years, and mass layoffs are hitting local hospitals hard. Funding for the federal government ran out this month, which adds more instability to a weakening economy. Instead of working with Democrats to keep the government open, President Donald Trump has walked away from the negotiating table.**Republicans are going all in on a government funding plan that will cause 80,000 Washingtonians to lose their health insurance and raise health care prices for all of us.** In August, I met with a member of the community who the Republicans' government funding plan will harm: Kathryn, a small business owner who lives in Bellingham. Since she and her husband are self-employed, Kathryn told me that her family paid roughly $30,000 this year for health insurance. If the Republican government funding plan goes through, they expect to have to pay $50,000 to $55,000 next year; more than they can afford. **Without tax credits, this hard-working family will be priced out of their health insurance.** Kathryn wrote to my office: "And why are we in this position? So Jeff Bezos can get a big tax cut. We need the (tax credits), and Jeff can give up some of his tax cut to pay for it." I couldn't agree more. These health care tax credits create economic freedom for small businesses and entrepreneurs to pursue opportunities they otherwise may not have. Starting a business takes risk, and these credits ensure unaffordable health care costs for your family don't hold you back. Allowing these credits to expire is a devastating continuation of the health care crisis the Trump administration started back in July, when the Big Ugly Law made the largest cuts to Medicaid in its history. Because of the Big Ugly Law, more than 328,000 Washingtonians will lose their health care insurance in the next few years. Taking health care away from hard-working people hurts all of us. Our family, friends, and neighbors will be forced to skip or delay getting the medical help that they need. More uninsured individuals create more risk for the health care system, and insurance companies pay for this risk by raising premiums. The Big Ugly Law's funding cuts are already forcing local hospitals to scale back. Providence Swedish in Edmonds and Seattle Children's Hospital collectively have laid off more than 100 staff in Everett, citing cuts to Medicaid and Medicare in the Big Ugly Law as part of the reason for the decision. Island Health in Anacortes expects Big Ugly Law funding cuts to cost millions, threatening its long-term sustainability. The Trump administration and Republicans have pushed the health care system to the brink. Now, they are shutting down the government so they can kick the health care system off a cliff. **At the midnight deadline, funding for the federal government ran out. Thousands of Northwest Washington state workers may be furloughed. Local farms may stop receiving disaster relief dollars. Active-duty members of the military may be required to report for duty but not receive paychecks.** The Trump administration is also threatening to permanently lay off massive numbers of federal employees if a shutdown occurs, effectively using hard-working civil servants — with families to support — as political pawns. More layoffs will further weaken the economy and make it harder for Americans to access the critical services the government provides. A Republican government shutdown would be yet another blow to the economy, courtesy of the Trump administration. **Because of reckless trade wars and stupid tariff policies, prices are up and the economy is down.** In August, the Bureau of Labor Statistics issued the worst jobs report in the past 15 years and reported the biggest jump in grocery prices in the past three years. Electricity prices are 6.2 percent higher than in the same month in 2024. **Republicans are inflicting more pain on Northwest Washington state families so they can double down on a health care crisis of their own making. Alongside House Democrats, I am fighting to lower the cost of health care and the cost of living for the people I represent.** Republicans must come to the negotiating table and work with Democrats to reverse the damage this administration has done. I will keep voting and keep fighting to make health care affordable and accessible, and to get our economy back on the right track. More soon, _Rick_ |

**I’m running to serve you for four more years because our work to deliver on the Arizona Promise has only just begun. From cutting taxes for middle-class families, small businesses, and veterans, to lowering childcare costs, to erasing medical debt for over 350,000 Arizonans, I’m focused on creating real solutions for our state’s toughest challenges – unlike the Washington politicians who prefer to play partisan games.**
I’m proud to be the first social worker ever elected governor in this country. Arizonans don’t need out-of-touch, career politicians who care more about billionaires than working families – they deserve leaders who actually understand the struggles we face.
I know what working families are going through — because I’ve lived it. I grew up in a working-class family in the heart of Tempe. I worked at Burger King and Pizza Hut to put myself through school. I lost my home in the Great Recession. I drove for Uber to make ends meet. My husband and I are still paying off student loans.
**That’s why every decision I make as governor is about delivering real results for families, not playing Washington political games.**
But all our progress is on the line in this election.
Donald Trump and National Republicans have made the Arizona governor’s race one of their top targets to flip red in 2026, and they’re prepared to spend _whatever it takes_ to do it. It’s why political experts at the _Cook Political Report,_ Larry Sabato’s _Crystal Ball_ , and _Inside Elections_ have already called this race a **pure toss-up. **
It’s why Trump has endorsed not one, but **TWO** of my *three* GOP opponents.
But unlike my Trump-endorsed opponents, I don’t have a vast personal fortune or far-right billionaires on speed dial. I have something far better: **You.**
[_**So please: Split a donation between me and Tina Kotek and become a Founding Donor of my re-election campaign today. But after becoming the first man to set foot on the moon...
Neil Armstrong reported a **[strange encounter](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7d4fa8-52ad-4c71-9756-3fd81f842c11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** he had in space during a post-mission debrief. And he wasn't the only astronaut to experience it.
NASA did their best to keep it secret... But now, unearthed **[NASA audio](https://substack.com/redirect/2d7d4fa8-52ad-4c71-9756-3fd81f842c11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** is blowing the lid off of everything.

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117052602/575193212/-343666687?refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20251010_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjE1NzdlYS0yMGE2LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vqGVZmsTMSJm8qf09iXQv5OYxw5_yH3AfempGsvPZAI=&emci=3580f04f-f6a5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=d21577ea-20a6-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=28008880)
